new_roles.title: General Manager - Automotive Manufacturing
new_roles.description:
"An Equal Opportunity Employer” It is the policy of North American Stamping Group to provide employment, training, promotion, and other conditions of Employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, age or status as a qualified individual with a disability or other status protected by law.
 
 
GENERAL SUMMARY
 
Plans, advises, consults, leads, and coordinates manufacturing, manufacturing support, and administration and organizational development activities for one or multiple facilities through Production, Engineering, Maintenance, Purchasing, Quality, Tooling, and Production Control to ensure efficient production of parts with the best material usage, quality levels, and service that exceed the customer’s expectations. Responsible for ensuring all key measures are met from plant and business operations. Leads and promotes matters related to safety, health, environmental, labor control, equipment, material, processes, and customer relations.
 
ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS
 
A. Serve as management consultant to assigned locations ensuring the management of the company aligns with North American Stamping Group, LLC standard operating procedures and provide subject matter expertise and assistance to increase operating and management efficiency.
 
B. Lead, plan, and manage all manufacturing activities and related functions at assigned locations including production, engineering, maintenance, purchasing, quality, tooling, and production control to ensure safety and quality and to meet and exceed customer and company requirements.
 
1. Lead manufacturing supervision in utilizing Total Quality Production System (TQPS) techniques to standardize processes/methods and to identify manufacturing problems and raw materials/components supply, and eliminate waste.
 
2. Ensure that feasibility studies are carried out correctly for the products to be manufactured at the facility, compatible with the footprint, investment, and quality capabilities planned.
 
3. Develop and monitor Lean activities and a manufacturing continuous improvement system.
 
4. Review launch products and engineering changes implementation and provide direction for successful launch.
 
5. Plan and organize layouts for line changes due to volume changes or manpower reductions.
 
6. Maintain contact with interdepartmental managers to provide feedback when dealing with process or material changes.
 
7. Hold daily staff meetings to communicate daily objectives and discuss successes, failures, and countermeasure activity.
 
8. Ensure NASG philosophies, systems, and processes are being followed at all times.
 
9. Maintain Master Capacity Plan for the facility for accurate budget and capital needs.
 
C. Lead and direct both strategic planning and tactical execution of manufacturing, manufacturing support, and administration functions.
 
D. Understand and execute all plant policies and procedures.
 
1. Structure and implement plant policies and procedures to ensure safe and efficient operation of the company and its associates.
 
2. Ensure alignment of plant policies and procedures, including associate handbook, with corporate policies and procedures.
 
3. Manage plant practices and procedures in compliance with company and industry standards (e.g., IATF16949 and ISO14001).
 
E. Lead development and management of annual plan, budget, key measures, operating efficiency, and cost control.
 
1. Develop annual plan and budget for plant aligned with corporate goals as the foundation to keep the plant moving in a safe, quality conscious, and efficient upward trend.
 
2. Review quotations of new products to ensure compliance with the manufacturing footprint and investment/manpower plans.
 
3. Administer annual plan that incorporates safety, quality, productivity, cost reduction, and associate morale.
 
4. Mutually establish goals and objectives with VP, Manufacturing quarterly.
 
5. Ensure plant goals are met and kept on track.
 
6. Develop, plan, and maintain the budget for plant including making adjustments to achieve targets. Maintain direct and indirect labor budgets while meeting quality and order fill requirements.
 
7. Review and track posted daily, weekly, and monthly goals (including Key Measure targets and results), spot potential problems, and lead in formulating and implementing short-term and long-term countermeasures and solutions.
 
8. Review and plan headcount weekly for labor cost control and operating equipment efficiency (OEE).
 
9. Support and resolve accounts receivable issues with the finance team to ensure timely collection.
 
10. Oversee the monthly reporting documents that are finalized for the plant, ensuring accuracy and completion. Report out monthly reports with targets. Conduct Monthly Management Review meetings.
 
11. Lead management discussions and planning sessions to help formulate cost reduction, waste reduction, product improvement, and problem solving activities, and present operational performance daily/weekly.
 
F. Act as key contact for customers and local industry groups.
 
1. Conduct plant tours and host customer meetings as required.
 
2. Ensure all parts are made to customer requirements in accordance with company policy.
 
3. Support activities to develop and improve customer relations and obtain future business opportunities.
 
4. Develop relationships with local industry groups including those related to manufacturing, automotive, human resources, education and training, legal services, and financial.
 
G. Manage and direct staff in assigned Manufacturing group with a focus on equipment, processes, human resource allocation, cost management, setting priorities, removing roadblocks, and leading through problem identification and resolution, and implementation of short- and long-term corrective actions to manufacturing problems.
 
1. Assign production and engineering staff to support all assigned projects on time and budget with accepted quality.
 
2. Lead staff in activities to meet and improve standard costs of operation both in material and output; minimize downtime; maintain good 5S at all times; reduce cost of quality internal/external failure and PPM; optimize material utilization; optimize raw material, WIP, and finished goods inventory; improve material specifications; and maintain preventative maintenance program.
 
3. Develop and maintain positive associate relations centered on mutual trust, dignity, respect, fairness, consistency, two-way communication, teamwork, and harmony.
 
4. Provide direction and motivation to associates emphasizing quality, efficiency, productivity, cost reduction, safety and health, and morale.
 
5. Ensure further development of associates through performance evaluation, development of training plans, feedback, coaching, and cascade training. Update associate training matrix and schedule any needed training.
 
6. Conduct monthly meetings with associates to communicate state of business.
 
MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS/REQUIREMENTS
 
 
**Education:** 

* Bachelor’s Degree in Business, Engineering, or related field preferred, or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
* Lean Six Sigma certification preferred.
* Auditor training through ISO 14001/IATF16949 preferred.

**Experience:** 

* At least 10 years of functional leadership experience as a manager in a manufacturing environment, preferably automotive stamping.
* Minimum of 12 years of relevant work experience in a manufacturing environment, preferably in automotive stamping, welding, and/or related components (e.g., seating, emissions, ride control, NVH, tooling, and other miscellaneous components).

**Personal/Technical Skills:** 

* General understanding and working knowledge of manufacturing, assembly, and welding equipment and tooling including design, automation, robotics, or manufacturing processes (and all secondary related processes) relating to automotive stamping.
* Working knowledge of tool, gauges and equipment design, automation, robotics, and/or manufacturing processes.
* Practical experience and working knowledge of Basic Equipment Care (BEC) and Preventive Maintenance Optimization (PMO) systems for machinery, tooling, and gauges.
* Practical experience applying Lean principles in an automotive environment.
* General understanding and practical work experience with automotive quality systems and processes.
* Working knowledge of material types specifications and characteristics used in automotive stampings.
* Practical experience applying Total Quality Production System (TQPS) principles in an automotive environment.
* Thorough understanding of company product, trade terminology, quality management and control systems and techniques, manufacturing processes including material controls, work flow, scheduling, kanban, and equipment and machine operation.
* Versed in statistical data entry and utilization of trend analysis.
* Ability to implement plans to control and maintain safety, quality, 5S, cost, and efficiency for assigned areas.
* Strong organization, time management, and planning skills and ability to manage multiple tasks with tight deadlines.
* Ability to teach managers, group leaders, team leaders, and associates in basic fundamental skills and facilitate Job Instruction Training (JIT).
* Must have the ability to monitor and adjust operating plans and budgets as needed to achieve operational goals, cost reduction objectives, and/or profitability targets.
* Will possess the organizational skills necessary to maintain company records in compliance with the Manufacturing Department and TS16949/ISO 14001 procedures.
* Must be able to work a fixed or rotating shift schedule, including daily or weekend overtime, and have the ability to work a schedule that allows completion of the job on a daily basis.

**Language Skills:** 

* Must be able to speak, read, write, and understand the primary language (English) used in the workplace.

**Computer/Software:** 

* Solid working knowledge and experience with Microsoft Office and other computer-based applications (e.g., MS Word, MS Excel, MS PowerPoint, MS Outlook, Internet, etc.).
* Working knowledge and experience with ERP/MRP software.

**Travel:** 
Must be willing to travel up to 30% to visit customers, suppliers, and other manufacturing sites.
 
 
North American Stamping Group is a drug-free and smoke-free workplace.

new_roles.title: Sr VP, Operations
new_roles.description:
**Join a Company That’s Redefining Air and Improving Lives**

At Broan-NuTone, we don’t just lead the residential ventilation industry in North America, we’re shaping its future. Through innovation, ingenuity, and a relentless focus on quality, we’re on a mission to be the most trusted and forward-thinking manufacturer of residential ventilation solutions.

Our impact is everywhere: in more than **110 million homes across North America**, where our products help families breathe easier every day. In fact, we move nearly **13 trillion cubic feet of fresh air annually**; a testament to the scale and significance of what we do.

Behind that impact are our **2,000+ entrepreneurs** working across four countries, driven by a shared passion for innovation and excellence. Our products are crafted in our three manufacturing facilities and supported by a network of trusted partners. Together, we bring to life a powerful portfolio of industry-leading brands, including **Broan-NuTone, Zephyr, BEST, and Venmar**.

**A Culture Built on Purpose and Values**

What truly sets us apart is how we work. Our Core Values, **Safety, Trust, Entrepreneurial Spirit, and Bias for Action**, guide every decision we make and every interaction we have. We’re proud to foster a collaborative, high-energy culture where ideas thrive, innovation is encouraged, and people feel empowered to make an impact.

Our purpose is simple yet powerful: **improving lives through better air.** Every product we create is designed to make homes healthier, more comfortable, and longer lasting; helping families flourish and giving professionals solutions they can trust. It’s meaningful work we can stand behind.

**Part of Something Bigger**

Founded in 1932, Broan-NuTone is a cornerstone of **Madison Air**, one of the fastest-growing companies transforming the future of air. In April 2026, Madison Air went public on the New York Stock Exchange (MAIR), reflecting its remarkable growth and momentum. Today, Madison Air includes:

* **8,000+ entrepreneurs worldwide**
* **$10 billion in enterprise value**
* **42 manufacturing facilities across 11 countries**

Together, we’re united by a bold mission: **to make the world safer, healthier, and more productive through the transformative power of air.**

**Ready to make your mark? Join us and help improve lives with better indoor air quality.**

**Business Job Title:** Sr VP - Operations

 

**Job Summary:** The Sr VP - Operations provides global leadership and oversight of Broan-NuTone’s factory operations and supply chain functions. This executive establishes and deploys the global operations and supply chain strategy, drives operational excellence, and determines the most profitable approach for meeting customer demand worldwide. As a member of the Executive Team, the role contributes to company vision and strategy while partnering with Product Development, Marketing, Sales, senior leadership, customers, and suppliers.

**Job Responsibilities:**

* Develop and communicate a three-year global operations and supply chain strategy aligned with the business strategy.
* Lead strategy deployment and continue implementing a formal SIOP process across Broan-NuTone.
* Advise senior leaders on operational and supply chain improvements that strengthen service, cost, quality, and efficiency.
* Develop and implement manufacturing, materials, quality, productivity, and process-improvement plans.
* Own operating budgets, capital plans, cost-reduction initiatives, and monthly, quarterly, and annual operating results.
* Establish global SQDCI metrics and a standardized KPI reporting process.
* Target 98% on-time-and-complete delivery while improving safety, quality, material and labor productivity, and inventory performance.
* Execute global sourcing, logistics, and supply-side initiatives while monitoring manufacturing technology and supply chain trends.
* Align customer requirements, supplier capabilities, and performance metrics with key business objectives.
* Negotiate with and influence supplier partners to support corporate goals and create strategic advantage.
* Champion lean manufacturing and continuous improvement throughout the manufacturing enterprise.
* Design a responsive global operations organization, including supply chain planning, make-versus-buy decisions, and local-market service strategies.
* Build and develop a world-class operations and supply chain team through coaching, succession planning, and external hiring when needed.
* Maintain the technical capabilities required to meet customer and market requirements, with continued emphasis on safety and quality.
* Create a flexible, responsive, metrics-driven culture that can react quickly to changing market conditions.

**Job Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Manufacturing Management, or a related field required.
* MBA or master’s degree in Engineering, Manufacturing Management, or a related field preferred.
* Minimum 10 years of successful leadership experience spanning manufacturing, strategic procurement, distribution, and logistics.
* Experience in a high-performing, global, complex durable-consumer-goods manufacturing company with at least $500 million in annual sales.
* Demonstrated responsibility for global operations and supply chain functions.
* Experience leading teams across the United States, Mexico, Asia, and/or Latin America.
* Previous plant leadership experience required.
* Residential or commercial building-products experience—or closely related durable-goods experience—preferred.
* Demonstrated results reducing cost, improving profit, streamlining operations, and producing sustained financial improvement.
* Expertise in lean manufacturing, global supply chain strategy, SIOP, sourcing, logistics, quality, productivity, and continuous improvement.
* Ability to operate effectively in an ERP environment.
* Strong collaboration, communication, conflict-management, executive-presence, and influencing skills.
* Strong business judgment, commercial acumen, learning agility, and comfort operating amid ambiguity and change.
* Hands-on, proactive leadership style that balances strategy and innovation with practical, accelerated execution.
* Fact-based and metrics-driven decision-making skills.
* Demonstrated ability to develop leaders, strengthen succession pipelines, and upgrade organizational capability.
* Ability to travel up to 25%.

*At Broan NuTone, we take pride in offering exceptional benefit packages and a highly competitive pay structure to our employees. Our comprehensive benefits include health, dental and vision insurance, company paid life insurance, disability insurance, retirement plans, paid time off, wellness program, education assistance, parental leave, and employee assistance programs. In addition, we provide a competitive pay structure that rewards our employees for their hard work and dedication, ensuring that they are compensated fairly for their contributions. Join our team and enjoy the peace of mind and financial stability that comes with our outstanding benefits and competitive pay.*

new_roles.title: SVP Manufacturing
new_roles.description:
**Position Summary**

The Senior Vice President, Manufacturing is the enterprise leader responsible for the strategy, performance, scalability, and continuous improvement of Mama’s Creations’ manufacturing network.

This executive owns the development and execution of an enterprise manufacturing strategy that enables profitable growth while delivering uncompromising safety, food safety, Grandma Quality, service, cost, capacity, and operational performance. The SVP will ensure Mama’s manufacturing capabilities evolve ahead of the Company’s growth, customer requirements, innovation pipeline, and acquisition strategy.

The role builds on Mama’s established “One Factory, Three Locations” operating model, creating common operating systems, performance standards, management routines, capabilities, and accountability across the manufacturing network located in NY/NJ.

The SVP Manufacturing will be a key member of the senior leadership team and a strategic partner to Operations, Supply Chain, FSQA, Engineering, Finance, People Operations, Culinary/R&D, Commercial, and other functions.

Base Pay: $250,000 - $300,000; Bonus Target: 40%; LTI Eligible

**Key Responsibilities**

Enterprise Manufacturing Strategy

* Develop and execute Mama’s multi-year manufacturing strategy aligned with the Company’s growth, profitability, innovation, and customer strategies.
* Translate the corporate strategy into clear manufacturing priorities, capabilities, capacity requirements, technology investments, and operating plans.
* Establish the roadmap for an increasingly integrated Mama’s manufacturing network, advancing the One Factory, Three Locations model.
* Determine when capacity should be created through existing facilities, expansion, automation, new facilities, acquisitions, or external manufacturing.
* Anticipate future production requirements and ensure that manufacturing capacity, capabilities, infrastructure, and talent are positioned ahead of demand.
* Regularly assess manufacturing footprint, capacity utilization, constraints, and investment requirements.
* This enterprise orientation is consistent with current external SVP benchmarks, which distinguish the SVP level through manufacturing strategy and footprint optimization rather than simply managing current production.

Manufacturing Performance & Operational Excellence

* Establish a consistent manufacturing operating system with common KPIs, operating reviews, accountability mechanisms, and problem-solving disciplines.
* Drive measurable, sustainable improvement across facilities using Lean manufacturing, structured problem-solving, root-cause analysis, and continuous improvement methodologies.
* Identify performance gaps and ensure corrective actions produce durable results rather than short-term fixes.
* Promote sharing of best practices across all manufacturing locations.
* Comparable manufacturing executives are expected to lead continuous process improvement, line efficiency, cost reduction, KPI management, benchmarking, technology adoption, and operational excellence.

Safety, Food Safety & Grandma Quality

* Establish a manufacturing culture where employee safety and food safety are non-negotiable.
* Ensure manufacturing processes consistently deliver Mama’s commitment to Grandma Quality.
* Partner closely with FSQA leadership to maintain compliance with applicable FDA, USDA, FSMA, HACCP, GMP and customer requirements.
* Ensure manufacturing leaders maintain sustained audit readiness and promptly address corrective and preventive actions.
* Ensure productivity improvements never compromise employee safety, food safety, product integrity, or customer requirements.
* Mama’s internal manufacturing leadership model already places food safety, regulatory compliance, audit readiness and Grandma Quality at the center of plant accountability.

Capacity, Capital & Automation Strategy

* Own the long-range manufacturing capacity plan.
* Develop and prioritize the enterprise manufacturing capital roadmap in partnership with Finance, Engineering, Reliability, Supply Chain, and other stakeholders.
* Establish rigorous business cases for capital investments based on capacity, productivity, safety, quality, reliability, labor reduction, growth, and ROI.
* Lead major facility expansions, production line additions, equipment installations, and manufacturing technology investments.
* Evaluate automation opportunities that improve capacity, consistency, employee safety, labor productivity, quality, and scalability.
* Ensure capital projects deliver intended financial and operational benefits following implementation.

Financial & P&L Leadership

* Own enterprise manufacturing budgets and overall manufacturing cost performance.
* Establish annual productivity and cost-improvement objectives across the network.
* Partner with Finance to understand manufacturing cost drivers and identify sustainable margin-improvement opportunities.
* Drive disciplined management of labor, overtime, yield, waste, downtime, supplies, maintenance, and other controllable manufacturing expenses.
* Ensure plant leaders understand the financial impact of operating decisions.
* Balance cost and productivity objectives with safety, service, Grandma Quality, employee capability, and long-term operational health.
* External benchmarks similarly position manufacturing VPs/SVPs as responsible for budgets, capacity, workforce requirements, cost control, quality and resource planning.

Manufacturing Organization & Leadership Development

* Build a high-performing manufacturing leadership organization capable of supporting Mama’s continued growth.
* Lead, coach, develop, and hold accountable senior manufacturing and plant leaders.
* Establish clear decision rights and accountability between enterprise manufacturing leadership and individual facilities.
* Build succession plans for critical manufacturing leadership positions.
* Partner with People Operations on organizational design, workforce planning, leadership development, performance management, employee engagement, and succession.
* Establish leadership expectations that reinforce accountability while maintaining Mama’s values and culture.
* Develop an internal pipeline of future Plant Directors, VPs, and manufacturing executives.

Workforce & Labor Strategy

* Establish the enterprise manufacturing workforce strategy in partnership with People Operations.
* Develop scalable labor models tied to production volumes, product mix, line capabilities, and operating schedules.
* Create greater consistency across plants in labor planning, overtime management, staffing models, skills development, and workforce utilization.
* Champion frontline leadership capability and supervisor development.
* Support strategies that improve attendance, retention, workforce stability, productivity, and employee engagement.
* Evaluate opportunities to reduce dependence on temporary labor and excessive overtime through improved workforce planning, scheduling, automation, and retention.

Reliability, Engineering & Technology

* Ensure manufacturing operations have the asset reliability and infrastructure necessary to achieve business objectives.
* Partner with Engineering and Reliability leadership to build preventive and predictive maintenance capabilities.
* Improve equipment uptime, OEE, line reliability, and maintenance planning.
* Champion appropriate manufacturing technology, automation, ERP/MES capabilities, data visibility, and digital tools.
* Establish disciplined post-implementation measurement to ensure technology investments deliver expected benefits.

M&A and Manufacturing Network Integration

* Develop manufacturing integration plans for acquired businesses.
* Bring acquired manufacturing operations into Mama’s operating system while thoughtfully preserving capabilities, practices, and cultural elements that create value.
* Identify network optimization and synergy opportunities following acquisitions.
* M&A diligence and post-acquisition operational integration are already part of Mama’s Regional VP Plant Operations scope, so I recommend making this substantially more strategic and enterprise-level at the SVP level.
* Cross-Functional & Executive Leadership
* Serve as the senior manufacturing partner to Supply Chain, Procurement, FSQA, Engineering, Finance, People Operations, R&D/Culinary, Sales and other enterprise functions.
* Ensure manufacturing readiness for new product commercialization, customer launches, promotions, and significant volume changes.
* Partner with the co-manufacturing organization to optimize allocation between internal and external manufacturing capacity.
* Provide the executive team with clear visibility to manufacturing performance, capacity, risks, investment requirements, and emerging opportunities.
* Present manufacturing strategy, performance, CapEx priorities, and major operational risks to executive leadership and the Board as requested.
* Mama’s existing co-manufacturing structure owns the external manufacturing network, including capacity, service, cost, quality and commercialization. The SVP Manufacturing should therefore partner closely with that organization rather than duplicate its responsibilities.

Culture & Values

* Lead in a manner that Commits to Craftsmanship, Honors Heritage, and Nurtures Relationships.
* Protect and advance Grandma Quality as the organization grows and manufacturing processes become increasingly sophisticated.
* Maintain visible leadership presence across manufacturing locations.
* Build a culture of disciplined execution, continuous improvement, transparency, respect, accountability, and pride in workmanship.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Operations Management, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Business, Food Science, or related discipline; advanced degree preferred.
* 15+ years of progressive manufacturing/operations leadership experience, with significant leadership experience in food, beverage, refrigerated/fresh foods, CPG, or another complex regulated manufacturing environment.
* 7+ years leading multi-site manufacturing operations or an equivalent enterprise manufacturing network.
* Demonstrated success leading large-scale manufacturing organizations through periods of significant growth and change.
* Deep knowledge of food manufacturing operations and applicable FDA, USDA, FSMA, HACCP and GMP requirements.
* Demonstrated ownership of manufacturing budgets, productivity programs, capital investment, and operating performance.
* Strong experience with manufacturing capacity planning, network optimization, equipment investment, and facility expansion.
* Proven ability to build and develop high-performing Plant Managers/Directors/VP-level leaders.
* Strong financial acumen and ability to translate operating performance into EBITDA and margin impact.
* Demonstrated experience establishing KPIs and operating rhythms that drive accountability and continuous improvement.
* Executive-level communication and influencing abilities.
* Bilingual English/Spanish capability beneficial.

**Job Number**26145030

**Located Remotely?**N

**Pay Range:** $82,000-$103,000 annually 
**Bonus Eligible:** Y

**JOB SUMMARY**

Responsible for communicating the concept of Total Quality Management through advising, coaching, training, and facilitating. Position works with direct reports, General Managers, and other staff to develop and implement quality assurance strategies. The position is responsible for ensuring that quality processes meet company’s mission and brand standards, target customer needs, ensure employee satisfaction, and focus on continuous improvement at the property level. .

**CANDIDATE PROFILE**

**Education and Experience**

* 2-year degree from an accredited university in Business Administration, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 4 years experience in the guest services, front desk, housekeeping, sales and marketing, management operations, or related professional area.

OR

* 4-year bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 2 years experience in the guest services, front desk, housekeeping, sales and marketing, management operations, or related professional area.

**CORE WORK ACTIVITIES**

**Managing Quality Assurance Goals**

* Coaches managers on adopting the Total Quality Management leadership style.

* Makes and executes the necessary decisions to keep property moving forward toward achievement of goals.

* Directs property quality efforts to address critical customer requirements.

* Facilitates process improvement teams, assuring use of the systematic processes, and improvement is achievable and measurable.

**Leading Quality Assurance Team**

* Trains team members and managers on problem solving, process improvement and strategic planning techniques

* Develops systems to enable employees to understand guest satisfaction results.

* Communicates a clear and consistent message regarding departmental goals to produce desired results.

* Coaches managers on adopting the Total Quality Management leadership style.

* Educates new employees on the foundations of the quality processes, how to use quality tools and their role in continuous improvement.

* Familiarizes employees with the daily quality production reports and how to spot trends in their work areas and initiate root cause analysis.

**Managing Quality Tools**

* Ensures that management practices at all levels are aligned with quality tools.

* Uses data collection methods to compile, display, track, and analyze defect trends.

* Demonstrates and communicates key drivers of guest satisfaction for the brand’s target customer.

* Analyzes issues and identifies trends.

**Managing the Guest Experience**

* Reviews guest feedback with leadership team and ensures appropriate corrective action is taken.

* Responds to and handles guest problems and complaints.

* Stays visible and interfaces with customers on a regular basis to obtain feedback on quality of product, service levels and overall satisfaction.

* Creates an atmosphere in all properties that meets or exceeds guest expectations.

**Managing and Conducting Human Resources Activities**

* Facilitates the development of creative solutions to overcome obstacles and ensures implementation to continually improve guest satisfaction results.

* Ensures employees are treated fairly and equitably.

* Ensures that regular, ongoing communication is happening in quality assurance.

* Fosters employee commitment to providing excellent service, participates in daily stand-up meetings and models desired service behaviors in all interactions with guests and employees.

* Incorporates guest satisfaction as a component of staff/operations meetings with an emphasis on generating innovative ways to continually improve results.

* Sets goals and expectations for direct reports using the performance review process and holds staff accountable for successful performance.

* Solicits employee feedback, utilizes an “open door policy” and reviews employee satisfaction results to identify and address employee problems or concerns.

* Ensures property policies are administered fairly and consistently, disciplinary procedures and documentation are completed according to Standard and Local Operating Procedures (SOPs and LSOPs) and supports the Peer Review Process.

* Conducts annual performance appraisal with direct reports according to Standard Operating Procedures.

* Champions change, ensures brand and regional business initiatives are implemented and communicates follow-up actions to team as necessary.

new_roles.title: Director, Manufacturing Supply Chain
new_roles.description:
The Director, Manufacturing Supply Chain will lead inventory planning, purchasing, supplier management, and production planning across a network of brands, manufacturing campuses, and interconnected sites. This leader will direct both the people and the processes for these functions. They will define, deploy, and enforce a standardized, multi-brand supply chain operating model that connects site-level execution to enterprise strategy, so that every campus operates to common planning standards, shared supplier strategies, and a single network view of demand, capacity, and inventory.

**The role combines two priorities: delivering excellence in execution of today's supply chain processes across the MSO manufacturing and supply network, and leading the transformation to standardized, simplified, and more efficient ways of working**
==========================================================================================================================================================================================================================================================

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**Team Leadership and Talent Development**
------------------------------------------

* Build, lead, and develop a high-performing team of planners, buyers, production schedulers, and inventory control professionals supporting multiple brands.

* Define the organizational structure, roles, and responsibilities needed to run a standardized multi-brand planning model.

* Set clear performance expectations, coach and develop leaders, and build succession for critical roles.

* Foster a culture of accountability, standard work, collaboration, and data-driven decision making.

**Standardized Multi-Brand Planning and Inventory Management**
--------------------------------------------------------------

* Design, deploy, and sustain a standardized planning and inventory management solution across brands and manufacturing locations.

* Establish common planning policies, including planning parameters, lot sizing, safety stock methodology, and inventory segmentation.

* Harmonize master data standards (items, BOMs, routings, lead times, vendors) to enable consistent planning output and reporting.

* Partner with IT and ERP owners to align system configuration with standardized processes.

**Inventory Planning**
----------------------

* Own inventory planning for raw materials, components, work-in-process, and finished goods.

* Lead the supply side of Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) and run the Sales & Operations Execution (S&OE) cadence.

* Balance service levels, inventory investment, and working capital against clear inventory targets.

* Manage excess, obsolete, and shelf-life inventory risk, and drive inventory accuracy through cycle counting and root cause analysis.

**Purchasing**
--------------

* Lead direct materials purchasing, including order placement, expediting, and delivery performance.

* Establish standardized purchasing processes and approval controls across brands.

* Partner with Strategic Sourcing on contracts, pricing, and lead-time commitments, and own tactical execution.

**Supplier Relationship Management**
------------------------------------

* Build and lead a supplier relationship management program, segmenting suppliers by spend, criticality, and risk.

* Run structured business reviews with key suppliers covering performance, capacity, cost, quality, and improvement plans.

* Drive collaborative planning with strategic suppliers, including forecast sharing, capacity reservations, and consignment or vendor-managed inventory where appropriate.

* Partner with Quality on supplier corrective actions and supplier development programs for underperforming suppliers.

* Resolve supply disruptions quickly through strong supplier relationships and clear escalation paths.

**Supplier Performance Metrics**
--------------------------------

* Define and deploy a standardized supplier scorecard used consistently across all brands and sites.

* Measure and report supplier on-time in-full (OTIF) delivery, lead-time adherence and lead-time trends, quality performance (defect rates and corrective actions), purchase price variance, and responsiveness.

* Use scorecard results to drive supplier reviews, improvement plans, and sourcing decisions.

* Provide leadership with clear visibility into supplier performance trends and supply risk.

**Alternate Sourcing and Supply Risk**
--------------------------------------

* Identify single-source, sole-source, long-lead-time, and capacity-constrained materials, and maintain a supply risk register.

* Lead alternate and dual sourcing strategies in partnership with Strategic Sourcing, Engineering, and Quality.

* Coordinate qualification of alternate suppliers and materials through supplier qualification and change control processes.

* Establish mitigation plans, including strategic buffers and safety stock, for high-risk materials.

**Production Floor Planning and Scheduling**
--------------------------------------------

* Own production planning and floor scheduling across multiple manufacturing processes.

* Build and maintain capacity plans for labor, equipment, and work centers, with a firm scheduling horizon that stabilizes the shop floor.

* Partner daily with site operations leaders to resolve constraints, sequence work, and improve schedule attainment.

* Reduce changeovers, expedites, and fragmented work orders to improve throughput.

* Support new product introductions, product transfers, and end-of-life transitions with integrated material and capacity plans.

**Business Partnership and Strategic Alignment**
------------------------------------------------

* Partner with brand leadership, Commercial, Finance, Quality, Engineering, Operations, and Distribution to align supply chain plans with business strategy.

* Translate business priorities into supply chain roadmaps and investment cases.

* Present risks, trade-offs, and recommendations clearly to executive leadership.

* Collaborate with supply chain leaders at other manufacturing campuses to align processes and share best practices.

**Standardized Metrics and Visibility**
---------------------------------------

* Define and govern a standardized KPI framework for planning, inventory, purchasing, suppliers, and scheduling, aligned across brands and align with other manufacturing campuses.

* Align on common data definitions and a single source of truth for supply chain performance.

* Deliver tiered dashboards, from daily floor metrics to monthly executive reviews, that support forward-looking decisions.

* Key measures include inventory turns, days of supply, excess and obsolete inventory, customer fill rate, backorders, schedule attainment, forecast accuracy, supplier OTIF, purchase price variance, and inventory accuracy.

**Process Transformation and Simplification**
---------------------------------------------

* Lead network transformation for planning, purchasing, supplier management, and scheduling processes. Ensuring optimized inventory balancing and production scheduling across multiple manufacturing locations.

* Map current-state processes, remove waste and variation, and deploy standardized future-state processes with documented standard work and training.

* Apply Lean, Six Sigma, and change management methods to drive adoption and sustain results.

* Evaluate and implement planning, analytics, and scheduling tools that deliver measurable value.

**Quality and Regulatory Compliance**
-------------------------------------

* Ensure supply chain processes comply with the FDA Quality Management System Regulation (21 CFR Part 820), ISO 13485:2016, and EU MDR 2017/745, including purchasing controls, supplier controls, and traceability.

* Own supply chain procedures and records within the quality management system and support audits and inspections.

* Lead or support corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) and nonconformance investigations related to supply chain.

**Qualifications**
==================

**Required**
------------

* Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Industrial Engineering, Operations Management, Business, or a related field.

* 10+ years of progressive manufacturing supply chain experience, including inventory planning, purchasing, supplier management, and production planning and scheduling.

* 5+ years leading managers and multi-functional teams.

* Proven success leading process standardization or transformation across multiple sites, brands, or business units.

* Demonstrated experience managing supplier relationships, supplier scorecards, and alternate sourcing programs.

* Experience in a regulated manufacturing environment; medical device strongly preferred.

* Strong knowledge of MRP/ERP planning, S&OP, inventory optimization, and capacity planning.

* Proven ability to define KPIs, build dashboards, and use data to drive decisions.

* Excellent communication skills with audiences from the shop floor to executive leadership.

**Preferred**
-------------

* ASCM certification (CPIM or CSCP) and/or Lean Six Sigma Green or Black Belt.

* Experience with Infor Distribution A+ or a comparable ERP, plus MES, WMS, and advanced planning systems.

* Working knowledge of FDA QMSR, ISO 13485:2016, and EU MDR requirements for purchasing, supplier controls, and traceability.

* Experience in multi-brand or post-acquisition integration environments.

* Proficiency with analytics tools such as Power BI, SQL, and advanced Excel.

new_roles.title: Director of Quality
new_roles.description:
**Company Overview**

Red 6 is an innovative Augmented Reality (AR) technology startup leading the way in synthetic air combat training. Our primary technology, supporting our ATARS product, enables pilots to simulate the cognitive challenges of flying while accessing realistic, scalable training in dynamic outdoor environments.

**Director of Quality**

Lead Red 6 into a scalable aerospace product organization.

Red 6 develops advanced augmented reality capabilities for aerospace and defense applications. We seek a hands-on, strategic Director of Quality to lead the next phase of our evolution into disciplined, repeatable product qualification and production. This leader will strengthen existing foundations while guiding the processes, evidence, and behaviors needed to meet customer, regulatory, safety, and aerospace industry expectations.

Success requires more than maintaining certifications. The Director will embed quality planning into product development, improve manufacturing and supplier readiness, and create a culture in which teams jointly solve problems before they become defects, delays, or compliance findings. Key results are building practical, auditable quality processes with Quality as a trusted partner across Engineering, Operations, Programs, and the supplier base.

**WHAT YOU WILL LEAD**

* Own the enterprise Quality strategy and roadmap, scaling the Quality Management System (QMS) to match product maturity, production volume, and customer commitments.
* Maintain and continuously improve AS9100 certification and audit readiness. Lead management reviews, internal audits, corrective action effectiveness, risk based thinking, and process ownership.
* Lead ISO 45001 occupational health and safety management system maturation and certification readiness, in coordination with accountable safety and operations leaders.
* Deploy practical Advanced Product Quality Planning (APQP) disciplines aligned to AS9145 where applicable, including quality planning, process flow, PFMEA, control plans, measurement system analysis, first article inspection, and production readiness reviews.
* Integrate Quality into design inputs, reviews, verification and validation, configuration control, design changes, manufacturing transitions, and product release criteria.
* Establish scalable document and record controls, product pedigree, serial level traceability, inspection and test evidence, nonconformance controls, material review, CAPA, and calibration systems.
* Develop supplier qualification, surveillance, performance scorecards, supplier corrective actions, and risk based oversight of contract manufacturers and critical suppliers.
* Partner with Engineering and Operations to strengthen hardware quality, reliability, manufacturability, process validation, FOD/ESD controls, and handling of nonconforming material.
* Improve the connection between Windchill PLM, Epsilon3 MES, Unanet ERP, and existing compliance tools to support controlled, usable, auditable data across design, build, and delivery.
* Lead customer quality engagement, audits, contractual quality deliverables, and coordination with defense and aerospace stakeholders as applicable.

**LEAD A COLLABORATIVE QUALITY CULTURE**

* Build a capable Quality team with clear roles, coaching, succession planning, and cross functional influence.
* Act as a constructive partner to Engineering. Translate standards and contractual obligations into design intent, risk, and measurable acceptance criteria rather than relying on clause citations alone.
* Distinguish nonnegotiable compliance outcomes from implementation choices. Invite Engineering and Operations to co-design efficient solutions.
* Create early quality engagement in program planning and design reviews. Resolve disagreements using evidence, risk, cost, schedule, and accountable decision ownership.
* Establish shared performance measures and a regular Quality–Engineering working cadence to reduce late surprises and unproductive escalation.
* Promote a just, learning oriented culture that encourages timely issue reporting, root cause analysis, and effective preventive action.

**QUALIFICATIONS REQUIRED**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
* Significant progressive aerospace or defense quality leadership experience, including building or scaling an AS9100 QMS and leading certification or surveillance audits.
* Demonstrated success moving products from prototype or development environments into qualified, controlled, repeatable production.
* Working knowledge of APQP per AS9145, AS9102 first article inspection, supplier quality, configuration management, CAPA, and risk based process control.
* Ability to influence senior technical leaders without defaulting to authority or unnecessary bureaucracy. Strong facilitation, coaching, and conflict resolution skills.
* Experience with customer and supplier quality requirements, quality metrics, and cross functional improvement programs.

* Ability to work on site in Denver and travel periodically to suppliers and other Red 6 locations.
* Must be US Citizen to have the ability to obtain and maintain a DoD Security Clearance.

**PREFERRED EXPERIENCE**

* ISO 45001 implementation or certification leadership; AS9115 awareness for deliverable software where relevant.
* DoD prime contractor interfaces, DCMA, DFARS, and applicable government customer quality requirements.
* Experience with PLM, MES, ERP, and integrated digital quality workflows, especially Windchill, Epsilon3, and Unanet.
* Lean Six Sigma, ASQ quality credentials, GD&T, hardware reliability, and complex electromechanical systems.
* Experience developing small teams into mature, business enabling quality organizations.

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE IN THE FIRST 12 MONTHS**

* Publish an agreed risk based Quality maturity roadmap with clear process owners and milestones.
* Sustain AS9100 compliance and close systemic audit or corrective action gaps with evidence of effectiveness.
* Introduce an appropriate APQP and production readiness framework for priority product lines.
* Improve supplier quality visibility, product traceability, and readiness of controlled manufacturing documentation.
* Demonstrate stronger Quality–Engineering collaboration through earlier issue resolution and fewer late stage quality surprises.
* Provide leadership with a concise scorecard covering escapes, rework, supplier performance, CAPA aging, audit findings, and readiness milestones.

Estimated Base Salary range dependent on skills and experience: $175,000 to $195,000

**Full-Time Employee Benefits**

* Healthcare, Dental, and Vision (100% coverage for Employees)
* Paid time off, including vacation, sick, paid holidays, and parental leave
* Short and Long-Term Disability
* Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
* 401(k) Retirement Plan
* Voluntary Worksite Benefits (Accident, Critical Illness, and Hospital Indemnity)
* May be eligible for a discretionary annual bonus based on individual and company performance, subject to plan terms.

**Note**

Red 6 reserves the right to change its current benefits program at any time, in a manner that is consistent with applicable federal and state regulations.

This job description is not a contract and confers no contractual rights, privileges, or benefits on any applicant or potential applicant. Red 6 has the right to change any and all terms of this job description, including, but not limited to, job responsibilities, qualifications, and benefits. Nothing in this job description constitutes an offer or guarantee of employment.

new_roles.title: Director of Chemistry, Small Molecule Process Development and Manufacturing
new_roles.description:
**About This Role**
 
We are seeking a highly motivated and creative Director of Chemistry to join our Small Molecule Chemical Development team. In this role, you will lead and mentor scientific and engineering teams as you guide project progression from early-phase through late-phase drug development. You will oversee the design and refinement of robust manufacturing processes for a wide range of small molecules, supporting pre - clinical and clinical therapeutics. This role is integral to advancing our scientific endeavors, driving innovation, and enabling the successful launch of new medicines through collaborative, safe, economical, and sustainable process development.

**Who We Are**

We are a team of organic chemists and chemical engineers engaged in the design of innovative processes which supply new medicines to patients. We focus on developing safe, economical, sustainable, cost - effective , and robust processes to support clinical trials and the launch of new medicines across various drug modalities. We are driven by first principles science, data-driven decision-making, and collaborative teamwork.

**What** **You’ll****Do**

* Lead c ollaborat ive development and manufacturing teams to design and conduct experiments to optimize and characterize the processes of Biogen assets with an emphasis on improvement in process understanding, robustness, and productivity.

* D esign, guide and execute experimental plans to advance the Biogen portfolio. You will be responsible for leading project teams towards the implementation of safe, efficient and robust chemical processes Biogen drug candidates. You will c ollaborate with development and manufacturing teams to optimize and characterize the processes of Biogen assets with an emphasis on improvement in process understanding, robustness, and productivity.

* Responsible for managing scientific colleagues, and mentoring, engaging, and preparing our future scientific and engineering leaders

* Develop the fundamental process knowledge needed to support the transition of chemical and biochemical processes from laboratory scale to manufacturing partners.

* Collaborate with our Process Engineering, Analytical Chemistry, Oligo Synthesis, Solid Form, and Separations colleagues to develop the knowledge and controls needed for the supply of clinical materials and characterization of processes to support regulatory filings.

* Communicate project team research results effectively by in reports and discussions in team meetings , including e ngage ment in CMC activities including authoring CMC section of INDs.

* Interact with Contract Research Organizations as project needs evolve , which may include travel

* Initiate innovative research projects to improve fundamental understanding and control of Biogen processes

* Expand on your Chemistry community presence professionally representing Biogen externally in consortia and conferences

**Who You Are**

You have a passion for exploring scientific concepts and are eager to contribute to the design and development and execution of cutting-edge technologies in the service of delivering drug cand idates for clinical trials . Your vision and dedication drive you to push the boundaries of scientific endeavors, ultimately impacting patient lives. You thrive in a collaborative environment where urgency, accountability, inclusion and integrity are shared value s .

* M.S. or PhD with 12 + years of relevant experience , including people management, in pharmaceutical or biotech settings is required

* Strong background in the theory and practice of pharmaceutical process chemistry and engineering , including command of synthetic strategies, impurity controls, analytical, purification and isolation techniques, process characterization , familiarity with process safety and tech transfer protocols, and good problem -s olving skills in the service of delivering non-clinical and clinical APIs and the phase appropriate knowledge packages for CMC support.

* Demonstrated experience in leading project teams involved in delivery of APIs across several modalities

* Ability to lead teams ethically, collaboratively , effectively, and cross-functionally

* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills are required along with the desire to work in a highly collaborative team environment .

**Preferred Skills:**

* Experience in engaging with external partners and representing the organization in external facing settings.

* Familiarity with regulatory requirements and CMC activities related to drug development.

 
Job Level: Management 

**Additional Information**

The base compensation range for this role is: $188,000.00-$258,500.00 

Base salary offered is determined through an analytical approach utilizing a combination of factors including, but not limited to, relevant skills & experience, job location, and internal equity.

 

Regular employees are eligible to receive both short term and long-term incentives, including cash bonus and equity incentive opportunities, designed to reward recent achievements and recognize your future potential based on individual, business unit and company performance.

 
 

In addition to compensation, Biogen offers a full and highly competitive range of benefits designed to support our employees’ and their families *physical, financial, emotional,* and *social well-being* ; including, but not limited to:

* Medical, Dental, Vision, & Life insurances
* Fitness & Wellness programs including a fitness reimbursement
* Short- and Long-Term Disability insurance
* A minimum of 15 days of paid vacation and an additional end-of-year shutdown time off (Dec 26-Dec 31)
* Up to 12 company paid holidays + 3 paid days off for Personal Significance
* 80 hours of sick time per calendar year
* Paid Maternity and Parental Leave benefit
* 401(k) program participation with company matched contributions
* Employee stock purchase plan
* Tuition reimbursement of up to $10,000 per calendar year
* Employee Resource Groups participation
 

 

**Why Biogen?**

We are a global team with a commitment to excellence, and a pioneering spirit. As a mid-sized biotechnology company, we provide the stability and resources of a well-established business while fostering an environment where individual contributions make a significant impact. Our team encompasses some of the most talented and passionate achievers who have unparalleled opportunities for learning, growth, and expanding their skills. Above all, we work together to deliver life-changing medicines, with every role playing a vital part in our mission. Caring Deeply. Achieving Excellence. Changing Lives.

 
 

At Biogen, we are committed to building on our culture of inclusion and belonging that reflects the communities where we operate and the patients we serve. We know that diverse backgrounds, cultures, and perspectives make us a stronger and more innovative company, and we are focused on building teams where every employee feels empowered and inspired.

 
 

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, marital status, race, color, national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, religion, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law. Biogen is an E-Verify Employer in the United States.

new_roles.title: Plant Manager
new_roles.description:
**Position Summary**

We are seeking an experienced Manufacturing Plant Manager to lead day-to-day operations within a small to mid-sized manufacturing and fabrication environment. This individual will be responsible for driving production performance, developing and managing teams, improving processes, maintaining safety standards, and ensuring the plant meets operational and business objectives.

The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience in assembly, steel components, fabrication, welding, or HVAC manufacturing, along with a proven track record of leadership and continuous improvement.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead and oversee daily plant operations, including production, assembly, fabrication, welding, and related manufacturing activities.
* Provide leadership, direction, and accountability to supervisors, production employees, and support teams.
* Develop and monitor Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) to measure productivity, quality, safety, efficiency, and overall plant performance.
* Identify opportunities for process improvement and implement solutions that improve productivity, quality, and profitability.
* Lead teams through organizational and operational changes while maintaining productivity and employee engagement.
* Work cross-functionally with other departments to coordinate production priorities, schedules, resources, and deadlines.
* Establish clear expectations and hold supervisors and employees accountable for performance.
* Develop supervisors and team members through coaching, training, and performance management.
* Ensure compliance with plant safety policies, procedures, training requirements, and applicable regulations.
* Coordinate and oversee safety-related activities, inspections, training, and corrective actions.
* Prepare accurate operational reports and maintain records related to production, safety, inspections, quality, and performance.
* Conduct and participate in production meetings, safety meetings, and operational reviews.
* Manage competing priorities and respond effectively to changing production demands and deadlines.
* Utilize technology and business systems to support plant operations, reporting, scheduling, and planning.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives and contribute to overall plant strategy and business objectives.

**Qualifications & Requirements**

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Industrial Management, Manufacturing Management, or a related field preferred.
* Equivalent combination of education and relevant industry experience will be considered.

**Experience**

* \*\*5–10 years of practical manufacturing experience

 \*\*, preferably in assembly, steel components, fabrication, welding, HVAC, or a related industry.
* Minimum of 5 years of supervisory or management experience within a manufacturing, fabrication, welding, or HVAC environment.
* Experience working in a small to mid-sized manufacturing or fabrication operation preferred.
* Demonstrated success leading teams and implementing process improvements in a manufacturing environment.
* Previous experience developing, implementing, and monitoring KPIs.
* Strong understanding of plant operations, production processes, and workforce management.

**Leadership & Technical Skills**

* Strong leadership presence with the ability to set direction, establish accountability, and develop high-performing teams.
* Ability to influence and collaborate effectively across departments and functions.
* Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills.
* Working knowledge of plant safety and compliance requirements.
* Excellent organizational and time-management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to prepare clear reports, maintain accurate records, and communicate operational results to leadership.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, Microsoft Visio, Microsoft Project, ERP systems, and other manufacturing/plant management software.

**Ideal Candidate**

The ideal candidate is a hands-on manufacturing leader who understands how to run a plant, develop people, improve processes, and drive results. They should be comfortable working in a fast-paced environment, making decisions, holding teams accountable, and partnering with leadership to achieve plant-wide goals.

**This is a leadership role for someone who can take ownership of plant performance and drive continuous improvement from the floor to the management team.**

You should be proficient in:

* Leadership / People Management
* Operational Metrics & KPI Management

new_roles.description:
Dairy Farmers of America (DFA), a dairy marketing cooperative owned by more than 12,500 family farmers. Our mark matters and it represents the wholesomeness of dairy that we share with our communities and loved ones. DFA manufactures a variety of dairy products, including cheese, butter, fluid milk, ice cream, dairy ingredients and more, under well-known and established regional brands. Our fingerprints touch thousands of brands across the marketplace, and we're passionate about delivering the simple pleasures of dairy to people everywhere, straight from our family farm-owners. We are proud to provide families with fresh delicious dairy products.

By joining DFA, you can help us continue to make a difference that matters. We care deeply about the well-being of our neighbors and friends, and we celebrate the diversity of our company and our world. It takes an incredible team to deliver the goodness of dairy and enrich our communities – come join us!

**GENERAL PURPOSE**

Direct and coordinate overall plant operations and priorities, and through managers, supervisors, and staff, ensure product is produced efficiently and within cost parameters. Provide work direction to management and employees within the guidelines of standard work rules, union contract provisions (if applicable), and employment policies. Is held accountable for achieving the plant's key performance indicators. Support the Continuous Improvement (CI) initiative to improve productivity, quality, efficiency of operations, and the facility's culture. Manage the overall operating budget including capital and expense projects. Direct personnel activities of department, such as recruitment, hiring, performance evaluations, and salary adjustments using independent judgment within the framework of established human resources policies and practices.

This plant manager job is a single incumbent role responsible for multiple plants or a large and/or complex plant that may also have an assistant plant manager(s) within the plant.

**JOB DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Manage plant operations in all areas of responsibility including administration, production, processing, packaging, quality, maintenance, warehousing, shipping, purchasing, safety, and environmental

* Establish production priorities to ensure product is produced efficiently and within cost parameters while maintaining safety, quality and sanitation standards; obtain optimum production and utilization of workforce, machines, and equipment

* Review and analyze production, quality control, maintenance, and operational reports to ensure compliance and determine causes of non-conformity with product specifications, customer requirements, FDA/government regulations, etc. Report any non-compliance immediately per established protocol

* Analyze plant operations to ensure that the facility maintains a leadership position in the industry and that it takes advantage of new processes and technologies that become available

* Interact with customers to meet their expectations on a variety of goals including operational, customer service, financial, and quality

* Develop, monitor, and drive plant key performance indicators (KPI's) related to safety, quality, productivity and finances. Strive for continuous improvement in KPI results. Promote continuous improvement culture and activities

* Understand plant P&L to drive plant performance; participate in the development of annual operating, capital and expense budgets; provide reliable and accurate information to finance to meet end-of-month closing schedules

* Manage or oversee all corporate, customer, and government audits to ensure compliance

* Conduct meetings with management and staff to ensure all operational issues are being communicated and addressed expediently with a common understanding of goals

* Communicate company goals and assist in establishing objectives that align with plant and company goals; communicate plant direction, focus and goals

* Provide appropriate direction, mentoring, training, and development planning for managers. Identify and retain highly effective personnel through proper selection, training and task assignment. Actively work with direct reports to cultivate capabilities and utilize strengths to support career development and succession planning efforts

* Maintain safe working conditions for employees and compliance with all company, state and federal regulations regarding health and safety issues

* Follow all DFA good manufacturing practices (GMP) and work in a manner consistent with all company regulatory, food safety, quality, and sanitation requirements

* The requirements herein are intended to describe the general nature and level of work performed by employee, but is not a complete list of responsibilities, duties, and skills required. Other duties may be assigned as required

**BENEFITS:**

* Health and Welfare benefits begin 1st of the month after start date
* 401(k) with company contribution – 100% vested at day one of eligibility
* Competitive pay
* Paid vacation and holidays
* Career growth opportunities – we promote from within!
* Comprehensive healthcare benefits
* Service recognition and employee rewards
* Employee referral program
* Tuition reimbursement
* Work for dairy farm families

Requirements:

**EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE**

* High school diploma or equivalent

* Undergraduate degree in related curriculum preferred

* 8 or more years' experience in a manufacturing environment, preferably food and/or beverage manufacturing

* 2 or more years' management experience

* Proven track record of improved results in the areas of quality, safety, service and cost

* Certification and/or License – may be required during course of employment

**KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES**

* Strong knowledge of manufacturing process flow and importance to process

* Strong knowledge of continuous improvement models

* Thorough understanding of regulatory laws and responsibilities as it relates to facility standards

* Proficient understanding of budgeting and cost control

• Skill in leadership and coaching; strong knowledge of principles and practices of supervision, training, and personnel management • Knowledge of and skill with Microsoft Office Suite and company computer systems

* Skill in critical thinking, analysis, mathematical calculations, and statistical evaluations

* Able to work in collaboration effectively and foster good teamwork

* Able to interact positively and work effectively with others (interpersonal skills)

* Able to think and use independent judgment in planning and organizing multiple tasks and information

* Able to demonstrate strong initiative

* Able to take appropriate steps to find solutions to problems

* Able to present options and ideas to current processes or procedures

* Able to handle challenging or conflict situations with tact and professionalism

* Able to communicate with various levels of personnel to ensure customers' needs and requirements are met

* Able to interpret and apply company policies

* Able to adapt and manage to change effectively

* Must be able to read, write and speak English

An Equal Opportunity Employer including Disabled/Veterans

 
 
Compensation: Competitive Salary

new_roles.description:
**Plant Manager – Furniture Manufacturing**

**Position Summary**

We are seeking an experienced, hands-on, and results-driven **Plant Manager** to lead our furniture manufacturing operations. This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced manufacturing leader to take ownership of plant performance, develop a strong leadership team, improve production processes, and make a direct impact on the success and growth of the facility.

The Plant Manager will oversee all aspects of plant operations, including production, safety, quality, scheduling, cost management, and employee development. This individual will provide leadership and oversight to department supervisors across the facility, ensuring all departments work together to achieve production, quality, safety, and operational goals.

The ideal candidate is a strong, people-focused leader with a solid manufacturing background who knows how to motivate teams, develop supervisors, improve processes, solve problems, and create a culture of accountability, teamwork, safety, and quality.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Plant Operations & Production**

* Direct and oversee daily manufacturing operations to ensure production goals, quality standards, and delivery expectations are consistently met.
* Coordinate activities across departments to maximize productivity, efficiency, and workflow.
* Identify and implement process improvements to reduce waste, control labor costs, and increase operational efficiency.
* Develop and monitor production goals, performance metrics, and operational procedures.
* Oversee equipment needs, maintenance coordination, and resource planning to support production demands.

**Leadership & Employee Development**

* Provide overall leadership, direction, and oversight to department supervisors across all areas of the manufacturing plant.
* Lead, coach, and develop supervisors to ensure effective management of their respective departments and teams.
* Establish clear performance expectations, goals, and accountability for department supervisors.
* Monitor departmental performance and work with supervisors to address challenges, improve productivity, and achieve production goals.
* Oversee employee training and development initiatives to build a skilled, productive workforce.
* Promote teamwork, communication, and collaboration between departments to ensure smooth and efficient plant operations.
* Foster a positive work environment focused on employee engagement, accountability, safety, quality, and continuous improvement.

**Cost Management & Financial Performance**

* Develop and manage plant budgets while maintaining effective cost controls.
* Identify opportunities to reduce labor and production costs without sacrificing quality or safety.
* Implement and maintain production cost tracking systems to evaluate manufacturing performance.
* Monitor labor utilization, productivity, and operating expenses to support profitability.

**Safety & Quality**

* Promote a safe working environment and ensure employees follow established safety procedures.
* Maintain high standards for product quality and accuracy throughout the manufacturing process.
* Monitor production processes and implement improvements to reduce defects, waste, and product returns.
* Ensure the facility has the necessary supplies, equipment, and resources to maintain safe and efficient operations.

**Systems & Process Improvement**

* Work closely with office personnel to improve administrative processes, reporting systems, and documentation.
* Establish and maintain effective production records and reporting procedures.
* Stay current with manufacturing technology, equipment, and industry best practices.
* Support improvements to systems and processes that enhance product quality, operational efficiency, and customer service.
* Perform other duties as needed to support the success of plant operations.

**Qualifications & Experience**

**Required Qualifications:**

* High school diploma or equivalent.
* Minimum of 5 years of manufacturing, production, scheduling, or operations experience.
* Minimum of 3 years of leadership or supervisory experience in a manufacturing environment.
* Demonstrated ability to lead supervisors and teams, manage performance, and drive operational results.
* Strong problem-solving, organizational, communication, and decision-making skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* 5–7 years of manufacturing operations or production management experience.
* Previous Plant Manager, Operations Manager, Production Manager, or similar leadership experience.
* Experience in furniture manufacturing or a similar production environment.
* Experience managing multiple departments and supervising department leaders.
* Experience managing production costs, labor efficiency, budgets, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Manufacturing, Operations Management, or a related field is a plus, but equivalent hands-on experience will be considered.

**Key Skills & Competencies**

* Strong leadership and team-building skills.
* Employee development and performance management.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Strong time management and organizational abilities.
* Manufacturing and operational knowledge.
* Results-oriented mindset.
* Problem-solving and continuous improvement.
* Attention to detail and accountability.

**What We Offer**

We value our employees and offer a benefits package designed to support their health, financial well-being, and work-life balance.

* Health Insurance available after 90 days.
* 401(k) retirement plan available after one year.
* Paid vacation.
* Additional company benefits.

**Work Environment & Physical Requirements**

This position operates in a furniture manufacturing facility. The work environment may include exposure to airborne particles, fumes, moving mechanical equipment, vibration, and elevated noise levels.

The position requires frequent standing, walking, reaching, and use of hands. Occasional sitting, climbing, balancing, bending, kneeling, crouching, and crawling may be required.

The ability to regularly lift or move up to 10 pounds and occasionally lift or move up to 25 pounds is required. Specific vision requirements include close, distance, color, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus.
