new_roles.title: Senior Director, Operational Excellence Manager
new_roles.description:
What We Need
 
Corpay is currently looking to hire a Senior Director, Operational Excellence Manager, within our Corpay Payables organization. In the role as a player coach, you will manage a team of operational excellence professionals and lead enterprise-wide initiatives that simplify operations, improve customer experience, accelerate business growth, and unlock the value of automation and Artificial Intelligence (AI). You will combine deep operational excellence expertise with a passion for digital transformation, Lean Six Sigma methodologies, AI-enabled process optimization, and organizational change. This individual thrives in ambiguity, influences across organizational boundaries, and delivers sustainable improvements that drive revenue, reduce costs, improve speed to market, and elevate performance. You will report to the VP, Operational Excellence and regularly collaborate with Operations, Product Management, Technology, Finance, Sales, and Customer Success to identify opportunities, challenge existing processes, and deliver innovative solutions that create measurable business value.
 
 
How We Work
 
As a Senior Director, Operational Excellence & AI Transformation, Corpay will set you up for success by providing:
 

* Company-issued equipment + remote access
* Formal, hands-on training

Role Responsibilities
 
 
**The responsibilities of the role will include:** 
Enterprise Transformation
 
Lead strategic operational transformation initiatives across multiple business functions.
 
Partner with executive leadership to identify opportunities that improve revenue, reduce costs, improve customer experience, and increase operational scalability.
 
Serve as an internal consultant, providing recommendations supported by data, financial analysis, and business cases.
 
 
Process Excellence
 
Conduct discovery workshops, value stream mapping, and current-state assessments.
 
Lead Lean Six Sigma initiatives focused on eliminating waste, improving quality, and reducing operational complexity.
 
Establish future-state operating models that enable sustainable growth.
 
 
Artificial Intelligence & Automation
 
Identify opportunities to leverage AI, intelligent automation, workflow technologies, and digital capabilities to improve operational performance.
 
Develop business cases supporting AI investments, including expected ROI and productivity improvements.
 
Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend scalable solutions.
 
Champion responsible AI adoption and establish best practices across operational teams.
 
 
Operational Readiness & Change Management
 
Lead operational readiness planning for strategic initiatives.
 
Develop implementation strategies, communications, training plans, and adoption metrics.
 
Partner with business leaders to ensure successful deployment and long-term sustainability.
 
 
Analytics & Business Performance
 
Establish baseline metrics and define measurable success criteria.
 
Design executive dashboards and KPI reporting.
 
Analyze operational trends and identify opportunities for continuous improvement.
 
Measure post-implementation results to validate business outcomes.
 
 
Cross-Functional Leadership
 
Influence senior leaders without direct authority.
 
Facilitate executive workshops and strategic planning sessions.
 
Partner closely with Product Management, Engineering, Finance, Operations, Customer Success, and Sales.
 
 
Qualifications & Skills
 

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Operations Management, or related field.
* Lean Six Sigma Black Belt certification (required).
* 12+ years of experience leading enterprise operational excellence, business transformation, or continuous improvement initiatives.
* Demonstrated experience applying Artificial Intelligence (AI), Generative AI, or intelligent automation to improve operational performance, enhance productivity, and deliver measurable business outcomes is required.
* Experience with enterprise AI platforms (e.g., ChatGPT Enterprise, Microsoft Copilot, Salesforce Agentforce, or similar) and the ability to identify and implement AI use cases within business operations strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated success leading large cross-functional initiatives from strategy through implementation.
* Experience delivering measurable business outcomes including cost reduction, revenue acceleration, productivity improvements, or customer experience enhancements.
* Strong executive communication and presentation skills.
* Advanced analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
* Experience building business cases supported by financial analysis and operational metrics.

Artificial Intelligence & Digital Skills
 
 
**Required experience with one or more of the following:** 

* Generative AI (ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, Salesforce Agentforce, Gemini, Claude, etc.)
* AI-assisted business process redesign
* Intelligent workflow automation
* AI productivity tools
* AI prompt engineering
* Digital transformation initiatives

**Preferred experience:** 

* Process mining
* Robotic Process Automation (RPA)
* Workflow automation platforms
* Salesforce ecosystem
* Business Intelligence tools (Power BI, Tableau, etc.)

Preferred Qualifications
 

* PMP certification
* Master's degree (MBA or related field)
* Experience in Financial Services, Payments, SaaS, or FinTech
* Knowledge of Operational Readiness methodologies
* Experience with customer experience transformation initiatives

Benefits & Perks
 

* Medical, Dental & Vision benefits available the 1st month after hire
* Automatic enrollment into our 401k plan (subject to eligibility requirements)
* Virtual fitness classes offered company-wide
* Robust PTO including major holidays, vacation, sick, personal, and volunteer time
* Employee discounts with major providers (wireless, gym, car rental, etc.)
* Philanthropic support with both local and national organizations
* Fun culture with the company

About Corpay
 
 
Corpay is a global technology organization that is leading the future of commercial payments with a culture of innovation that drives us to constantly create new and better ways to pay. Our specialized payment solutions help businesses control, simplify, and secure payment for fuel, general payables, toll and lodging expenses. Millions of people in over 80 countries around the world use our solutions for their payments.
 
At Corpay, we are committed to fostering an inclusive and respectful workplace where employees are valued for their diverse perspectives, experiences, and contributions. We believe that diversity, equity, and inclusion strengthen our teams, drive innovation, and support our continued success globally.
 
As part of our hiring process, offers of employment may be subject to the successful completion of pre-employment screening conducted by an authorized third-party provider, in accordance with applicable laws and Corpay policies. Screening requirements may include employment references, identity verification, criminal record checks, financial or sanctions screening, and other background checks relevant to the role and permitted by local law.
 
**Notice to Recruitment Agencies and Search Firms:** Corpay does not accept unsolicited resumes from agencies or search firms without a valid written agreement in place. Any unsolicited candidate submissions will become the property of Corpay, and no fees will be paid related to such submissions.
 
**Learn more about Corpay:** https://www.corpay.com
 
 
Transparency & Compliance
 
 
Equal Opportunity Employer
 
Corpay is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, marital status, genetic information, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Corpay is committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where individuals are respected and valued for their diverse perspectives, experiences, and contributions. If you require reasonable accommodation during any part of the application or interview process, please notify a representative of the Human Resources Department.
 
 
Use of Artificial Intelligence in Hiring
 
Corpay may use artificial intelligence (AI) and other technology-enabled tools to support certain aspects of the recruitment process, such as application screening, candidate assessment, or interview scheduling. These tools are designed to enhance efficiency, consistency, and fairness throughout the hiring process. AI tools do not make final hiring decisions. All employment decisions involve human review. Corpay is committed to the responsible use of AI, including appropriate oversight and safeguards designed to support fair and unbiased outcomes.
 
 
Candidate Privacy Notice
 
For information about how Corpay processes personal information during the recruitment process, please review our Candidate Privacy Notice: https://www.corpay.com/privacy-policy.
 
 
Pay Philosophy
 
Corpay is committed to fair, equitable, and transparent compensation practices. Compensation decisions are based on objective, job-related factors including skills, experience, qualifications, and market benchmarks. Where required by applicable law, salary or compensation ranges will be included in the job posting or provided prior to the interview process, where required by applicable law. Additional compensation elements such as bonuses, incentives, benefits, or variable pay may apply where applicable.

Director of Operations - Hybrid

**Role Overview:**

We are seeking a high-caliber, transformative **Director of Operations** to lead, scale, and optimize our operations. In this role, you will serve as a strategic leader responsible for driving operational excellence, customer advocacy, and regulatory integrity across a multi-faceted organization.

You will move beyond routine contact center management to steer a dynamic organization comprised of specialized internal operational teams—covering strategic readiness, advanced customer advocacy, and complex fraud/escalation management—alongside large-scale BPO vendor partners managing ~200+ frontline agents.

You bring a blend of strategic vision, process optimization discipline, vendor governance, and high-impact people leadership required to elevate operational standards and deliver best-in-class customer experiences.

**You have a proven track record of:**

* **Large-Scale Operations Leadership**: Successfully leading multi-site contact center operations combining internal teams and offshore/nearshore vendor partners of 200+ headcount.
* **Operational Transformation**: Transforming reactive service centers into proactive, quality-focused customer advocacy hubs through structured process engineering.
* **Escalation & Fraud Management**: Effectively mitigating enterprise risk through robust Tier 2 & 3 complaint handling, fraud prevention protocols, and regulatory adherence.
* **Vendor Operations Governance**: Driving rigorous SLA performance, cost efficiency, and quality alignment across third-party BPO vendor organizations.

**What you’ll do:**

The Director of Operations maintains end-to-end accountability for operational strategy, performance delivery, vendor oversight, and organizational readiness.

* **Leadership Reach**: Direct oversight of Department Managers, Unit Managers (UMs), and Vendor Managers (VMs) across internal and external business units.
* **Core Internal Operations**:
 + **Strategic Operations:** Driving CX quality call listening, 1:1 and group coaching/training, operations readiness, and training materials maintenance.
 + **Customer Advocacy:** Overseeing high-touch inbound customer service, task execution, complex account resolution, and U.S. transfer handling.
 + **Escalations and Fraud**: Leading high-severity escalated problem solving, fraud operations, customer complaint research and resolution, and escalation follow-ups.
* **Core External Operations:**
 + Governance and SLA performance tracking for primary vendor partners overseeing a network of ~200+ non-associate vendor agents performing inbound calls and funding workflows.

**Key Focus Areas:**

* Reimagine end to end Operations in this era of AI
* Strategic Leadership & Governance to formulate and execute long-term operational strategies and partner cross functionally
* Partner cross-functionally with Product, Business Analysis, and Process teams to establish and update processes, policies, procedures, and standards
* Define operational KPIs, quality targets, and SLA metrics to ensure consistent service delivery, funding accuracy, and customer satisfaction
* Direct vendor management leads to oversee third-party partners, ensuring ~200+ vendor agents adhere to operational guidelines and productivity benchmarks
* Risk, Fraud, & Complaint Resolution spanning complex problem solving and root-cause analysis
* Ensure business readiness for product launches, process updates, and technology enhancements across all operational sub-functions
* Mentor, develop, and inspire a multi-layered leadership team, cultivating a culture of accountability, continuous learning, and high performance.
* Optimize talent allocation and capacity planning across teams to handle volume fluctuations dynamically.

new_roles.description:
**Job Description**
-------------------

The Portfolio Group, under the Workplace Experience Group umbrella, delivers seamless experiences from the breakroom to the boardroom, providing a signature suite of services for each unique business portfolio. Our team builds partnerships that excel, creating experiences that break the mold, where convenience, consistency, and excellence are a given. One Partner. Infinite Solutions.

As a District Manager, you will provide overall vision, planning, direction, and control to assigned units for a large and complex geographic district normally generating $30-50M+ in revenue. This key leadership role is accountable for execution of our General Management program, with a focus on growth, cost and productivity, leading people and delivering financial commitments.

Whether focused on multiple sites for a large client or multiple clients, the key success measures of a District Manager include Revenue Growth, EBIT, Margin, Consumer Satisfaction, Client Loyalty and Employee Engagement.

In this role, frequent travel to client sites throughout the district is expected.

**Compensation Data**
---------------------

COMPENSATION: The Salaried rate for this position is $160,000.00 to $175,000.00. If both numbers are the same, that is the amount that Aramark expects to offer. This is Aramark's good faith and reasonable estimate of the compensation for this position as of the time of posting.

BENEFITS: Aramark offers comprehensive benefit programs and services for eligible employees including medical, dental, vision, and work/life resources. Additional benefits may include retirement savings plans like 401(k) and paid days off such as parental leave and disability coverage. Benefits vary by location and are subject to any legal requirements or limitations, employee eligibility status, and where the employee lives and/or works. For more information about Aramark benefits, click here Aramark Careers - Benefits & Compensation

There is no predetermined application window for this position, the position will close once a qualified candidate is selected. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with all applicable laws, including, but not limited to all applicable Fair Chance Ordinances and Acts. For jobs in San Francisco, this includes the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

**Job Responsibilities**
------------------------

The successful candidate demonstrates capability across the following dimensions:

* Leadership - Establish overall ownership and accountability of operational management and financial performance of multiple accounts and units. Model key leadership behaviors and ensure the highest levels of safety, quality and service excellence for employees, clients, and consumers. Coach & mentor employees by crafting a shared understanding about how and what needs to be achieved. Reward and recognize employees. Identify and engage top talent and develop team members to their fullest potential within the organization. Plan and lead team management meetings. Ensure safety and sanitation standards in all operations.
* Client Relationship - Establish and maintain effective client and customer rapport for a mutually beneficial business relationship. Identify client needs and communicate operational progress. Understand contractual obligations and leverage opportunities. Facilitate and support new business and retention activities. Ensure team completes customer satisfaction surveys in all locations.
* Financial Performance - Build revenue and manage budget with sensitivity to costs and client needs. Ensure the completion and maintenance of P&L statements for the district. Provide oversight and take ownership to deliver client and company financial targets using Aramark systems. Understand performance metrics, data, order and inventory trends; educate teams on key levers to improve margins.
* Productivity - Lead managers in implementing and maintaining corporate management agenda for labor and financial initiatives. Ensure value through efficient operations, appropriate cost controls, and profit management. Ensure consistent application of Aramark's operating standards and processes (Operational Excellence) with particular focus on efficiency standards. Understand end to end supply chain and procurement process and systems; ensure only authorized suppliers are used.
* Compliance - Ensure unit managers maintain a safe and healthy environment for clients, customers and employees. Follow all applicable policies, rules and regulations, including but not limited to those relating to safety, health, and wage and hour.

At Aramark, developing new skills and doing what it takes to get the job done make a positive impact for our employees and for our customers. In order to meet our commitments, job duties may change or new ones may be assigned without formal notice.

**Qualifications**
------------------

In order to be prepared for this leadership role, qualified candidates will possess:

* Proven leadership experience, typically acquired over 5-10 years, including P&L responsibility within the hospitality, retail, facilities, direct store delivery or food and beverage industries.
* Demonstrated leadership skills with a broad knowledge of management practices, business judgement and client/consumer interaction.
* Confirmed ability to hire, assess, develop and grow hard-working talent.
* Comfortable reading, understanding, and implementing contractual requirements, including identifying opportunities within contract terms and conditions to address operational issues.
* Established communication and teamwork skills to work with all levels on the organization from the front line associate through leadership.
* Proven success in a repeatable business model, including leading through change and turnaround initiatives.
* Bachelor's degree is generally required to be successful; advanced degree in business or related field is preferred.

**Job Description Summary:**

**Location: St. Louis or Kansas City.**

 

This role serves as the steward of our HoReCa & FSOP strategy across our mainstream Bottler Partners. We are looking for candidates with bottling or general management experience who can build relationships and execute our strategies across our network while navigating market dynamics, integrating business strategies, and driving excellence in execution.

 

**What You'll Do for Us**
=========================

 

* Own On‑Premise (Hotels, Restaurants, and Cafés (HoReCa) + Foodservice & On‑Premise (FSOP) + Local Market Plans (LMP for Mainstream bottlers

* Responsible for weekly/monthly performance management, including reporting on revenue, volume, share, and transaction metrics.

* Monitors performance versus execution objectives, re-plans as necessary, and provides feedback to key stakeholders.

* Executes the HoReCa commercial strategy and collaborates directly with bottling partners for local market execution, ensuring the alignment of strategic goals.

* Responsible for collaborating on contingency plans to deliver annual business plan performance, covering key metrics such as revenue, volume, share, net outlets, SOVI (share of visual inventory), and pricing.

* Assess bottler businesses’ high-level strategies and short- vs. long-term decision-making to prevent integration disruptions and ensure feasibility.

* Define and leverage critical measures to evaluate strategic success and align initiatives with the company’s broader goals.

* Collaborate with bottlers to optimize operational bottler-packaging-product-channel (OBPPC) frameworks and local initiatives.

* Navigate channel strategies and develop precise action plans catered to diverse markets to align with profitability and competitive needs.

* Foster strong relationships with local bottlers and external stakeholders by managing governance routines and resolving bottling contracts and national supply chain agreements.

* Negotiate value-driven solutions by leveraging evidence-based arguments and creative, strategic thinking while balancing transactional goals with long-term relationship value.

* Evaluate regional dynamics, consumer demand patterns, and bottler investment needs to optimize strategies.

Ensure real-time reporting and action plans address competitive pressures and enhance market penetration. 

 

**Qualifications & Requirements**
=================================

 

* Bachelor’s degree in business, Finance, Marketing, or Management with a master’s degree preferred.

* 7+ years of experience in a Consumer-Packaged Goods (CPG) or related industry, with a focus on direct sales, key account management, or franchise management. Experience should include proven P&L ownership and the ability to deliver measurable business results.

* Previous experience working directly with bottlers, distributors, or manufacturing partners in the Food & Beverage sector. Familiarity with annual business planning, distributor negotiations, and commercial strategy execution is essential.

* Demonstrated success in creating and executing business plans aligned with long-term objectives and informed by deep insights into revenue growth, market conditions, and customer segmentation trends.

* A track record of successfully monitoring performance metrics (revenue, volume, share, transactions) and adapting strategies to achieve positive outcomes. Candidates should be familiar with methodologies for reporting and analyzing key performance indicators (KPIs).

* Expertise in managing a portfolio across diverse distribution channels and customer types. Proven ability to apply market segmentation strategies and action plans that drive region-specific results and improve system efficiency.

* Strong capability to manage, negotiate, and resolve contracts, including National Supply Chain agreements and governance routines, with a focus on maximizing value while maintaining positive relationships. Provides evidence-based, creative solutions during negotiations to achieve win-win outcomes.

Ability to thrive in dynamic environments where priorities shift and market conditions change rapidly. Candidates must have demonstrated experience adapting plans and strategies to navigate uncertainty while maintaining focus on long-term goals.

new_roles.description:
**Job Description Summary:**

**Director, Franchise Operations**

**Location:** Tampa or Orlando FL;
 
**Reports To:** Vice President, Franchise Leadership

The **Director, Franchise Operations** serves as the senior franchise leader for Coca‑Cola Florida’s Advanced Hydration portfolio with full accountability for driving system alignment, execution excellence, and growth across Coca-Cola Florida’s territory. This role is highly strategic and executionally focused, operating at the intersection of brand leadership, bottler partnership, commercial execution, and enterprise influence to unlock accelerated growth across the Advanced Hydration portfolio. The role balances hands‑on operational leadership with long‑term strategic vision, translating enterprise priorities into flawless marketplace execution across the Advanced Hydration portfolio.

**What You’ll Do for Us**

 

**Franchise & Bottler Leadership**

* Serve as the franchise leader for the Coke Florida, aligning Coca‑Cola, bottlers, and customers around shared growth priorities

* Energize and enable bottling partners through clear direction, strong governance, and disciplined execution

* Build trusted, high‑impact relationships across the Regions and Sales Center levels

* Act as a strategic advisor to bottler leadership, supporting volume, revenue, profitability, and executional excellence

**Market Execution & Operations**

* Own end‑to‑end market execution across channels, ensuring national strategies are translated into local success

* Drive excellence across sales, merchandising, innovation launches, customer activation, and operational readiness

* Monitor and manage volume, revenue, gross profit, transaction incidence, and share performance

* Identify execution gaps, root causes, and corrective actions to improve marketplace results

* Ensure alignment across marketing, shopper, supply chain, finance, and operations teams

**Strategic Planning & Growth Agenda**

* Lead development and activation of the Coke Florida business plan, aligned with NAOU, Coke Florida, and The Coca Cola Company priorities

* Translate national and regional strategies into market‑specific plans that deliver sustainable growth

* Champion portfolio transformation

* Identify white‑space opportunities and pilot initiatives that can scale across the system

**Brand, Marketing & Customer Leadership**

* Serve as the market steward for Coca‑Cola’s brands, ensuring flawless brand execution and relevance

* Partner with marketing and PACS (Public Affairs, Communications and Sustainability) to activate brand strategies, innovation, and campaigns in market

* Lead customer‑centric strategies that strengthen relationships with key on‑premise and off‑premise customers

* Ensure Coke Florida consistently reflects Coca‑Cola’s highest standards of brand presence and execution

**People & Organizational Leadership**

* Be a Role Model for our high‑performing team, fostering accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement

* Build strong cross‑functional partnerships across Coca‑Cola system stakeholders

* Share best practices, elevate talent, and contribute to enterprise capability building

Create a culture of results, curiosity, learning, inclusion, and ownership 



**Requirements & Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Management, or related field

* Minimum 7+ years of experience in Consumer Packaged Goods, franchise leadership, sales, operations, or general management

* Demonstrated success leading complex, multi‑stakeholder organizations

* Proven experience driving P&L performance, executional excellence, and growth

* Strong executive presence with the ability to influence at senior internal and external levels
* Experience within the Coca‑Cola system or similarly structured franchise organizations

* Background spanning sales, operations, marketing, commercial strategy and strategic planning

Track record of leading high‑visibility markets or enterprise‑critical initiatives 



**Critical Success Factors**

* Strategic thinker with strong execution bias

* Exceptional relationship builder adept at stakeholder management with senior Coca-Cola Company, bottler, and customer leaders

* Ability to balance short‑term performance with long‑term brand and system health

* Comfortable operating in ambiguity with high expectations and visibility

Passion for The Coca‑Cola Company and our brands, and building a world‑class franchise model 



**What We’ll Do for You**

* Enable you to lead complex system initiatives that reshape how Coca‑Cola competes in market and builds future growth capabilities across our bottling partners.

* Provide scope to apply transformation leadership that bridges strategic thinking and market execution within a collaborative, growth-oriented environment.

* Offer opportunities to build and enhance system capabilities that make our franchise network more agile, data-enabled, and efficient.

* Support your development as a transformation leader through exposure to regional and enterprise-level challenges that strengthen long-term business readiness.

All persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification form (Form I-9) upon hire.

**Skills:**

Annual Business Planning, Business Plan Implementation, Capacity Planning, Channels Strategy, Contract Management, Customer Relationship Management (CRM), Distribution Operations Management, Financial Performance Management, Negotiation, Strategic Leadership, Teamwork

**Pay Range:**

United States: 145,000 - 169,000 USD


*Base pay offered may vary depending on geography, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. A full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the position, is offered.*

**Annual Incentive Reference Value Percentage:**

30

*Annual Incentive reference value is a market-based competitive value for your role. It falls in the middle of the range for your role, indicating performance at target.*

**Location(s):**

United States of America

**City/Cities:**

Atlanta

**Travel Required:**

26% - 50%

**Relocation Provided:**

Yes

**Job Posting End Date:**

November 5, 2026

**Our Purpose and Growth Culture:**

We are taking deliberate action to nurture an inclusive culture that is grounded in our company purpose, to refresh the world and make a difference. We act with a growth mindset, take an expansive approach to what’s possible and believe in continuous learning to improve our business and ourselves. We focus on four key behaviors – curious, empowered, inclusive and agile – and value how we work as much as what we achieve. We believe that our culture is one of the reasons our company continues to thrive after 130+ years. Visit Our Purpose and Vision to learn more about these behaviors and how you can bring them to life in your next role at Coca-Cola.

existing_roles.title: Head of Quality
existing_roles.description:
**About Us**
============

Det-Tronics is a global technology leader in industrial life safety, delivering advanced flame and gas detection, automation control and hazard mitigation solutions that help save lives, protect valuable assets and safeguard critical operations. With more than 50 years of experience, we serve mission-critical environments across offshore and onshore energy, gas turbines, clean energy, and industrial and defense markets. Our engineering expertise, rigorously tested products and global service capabilities help customers address complex safety challenges in some of the world’s most demanding environments. At Det-Tronics, our work has a clear purpose: advancing life safety technology to protect people, preserve assets and support reliable operations around the world.

**The Opportunity**
===================

Lead quality where product performance has a direct impact on safety—and help shape what quality can become. As Head of Quality and a member of the Senior Leadership Team, you will set the quality strategy for Det-Tronics, develop a strong organization and bring fresh thinking to how we prevent problems, learn and make decisions.

This role combines strategic leadership with hands-on engagement across supplier, manufacturing and product quality and the quality management system. Bring your curiosity and enjoy the challenge of modernizing how quality works: simplify processes, connect data and put digital and AI tools to practical use. You will build capability across the business and help teams reach sound decisions faster.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**Quality Strategy and Team Leadership**
----------------------------------------

* Translate business objectives into a quality strategy, annual operating plan, budget and resource priorities; deliver measurable results aligned with long-term growth goals.
* Lead, coach and develop the quality team; set clear expectations, strengthen technical and leadership capability, and build succession and development plans.
* Partner with Operations, Engineering, Supply Chain, Product Management and Service to embed quality into daily decisions and resolve competing priorities.

**Organizational Training and Development**
-------------------------------------------

* Own the organization’s quality training strategy in partnership with HR and functional leaders; identify skill gaps and develop role-based learning for onboarding, qualification and ongoing development.
* Create and deliver practical training, digital learning and job aids on quality standards, procedures, problem solving and new tools; coach and verify effectiveness through demonstrated skills and performance improvements.

**Quality Management System and Compliance**
--------------------------------------------

* Own and continuously improve the quality management system, aligning standardized processes with business needs, ISO 9001 requirements and applicable customer, regulatory and approval agency requirements.
* Lead management reviews and internal and external quality audits; ensure findings are addressed promptly and corrective actions are effective and sustained.
* Strengthen document control, process discipline, traceability, change control and risk management; partner with Engineering and Approvals to maintain product compliance.

**Manufacturing and Supplier Quality**
--------------------------------------

* Improve incoming material quality and production first-pass yield; reduce defects, scrap, rework and Cost of Poor Quality through disciplined analysis and improvement projects.
* Provide leadership for supplier qualification, performance management and development in partnership with Supply Chain; ensure effective supplier corrective actions and new part qualification.
* Oversee nonconforming material controls, Material Review Board processes, inspection strategies and corrective and preventive action; verify root causes and prevent recurrence.

**Product Quality and Customer Experience**
-------------------------------------------

* Partner with Engineering and Operations throughout new product development and sustaining activities to address quality risks, establish appropriate quality controls and support production readiness.
* Lead timely containment, investigation and resolution of customer quality issues; communicate clearly with customers and internal stakeholders and turn field and warranty findings into preventive action.
* Reduce warranty costs and repeat issues while improving customer experience, loyalty and relevant feedback measures, including Net Promoter Score.

**Continuous Improvement and Performance**
------------------------------------------

* Promote a proactive quality culture through Lean and Six Sigma methods, practical problem solving and shared accountability for process and product excellence.
* Establish and review quality dashboards covering first-pass yield, supplier defects, customer complaints, warranty performance, corrective action effectiveness and Cost of Poor Quality.
* Use data to prioritize improvements, validate results and communicate progress, risks and business impact to the Senior Leadership Team.

**Digital Quality and AI**
--------------------------

* Lead a practical digital quality roadmap with IT and business partners; connect quality data, simplify workflows and automate routine reporting so teams can focus on prevention and faster decisions.
* Pilot and scale AI tools for applications such as trend detection, analysis of customer and supplier issues, knowledge retrieval and training content development; validate outputs and measure improvements in speed, quality and usability.
* Be a visible role model for digital adoption: use the tools yourself, encourage experimentation and coach teams to build confidence while protecting data and maintaining human accountability for quality decisions.

**Required Qualifications**
===========================

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, quality, manufacturing or a related technical discipline.
* 10 or more years of progressive quality experience in manufacturing, including at least 5 years leading quality teams and improvement initiatives.
* Demonstrated leadership across quality management systems, manufacturing quality, supplier quality and customer issue resolution in a technically complex or regulated product environment.
* Experience owning or leading an ISO 9001 quality management system, audits, management reviews and corrective action processes.
* Proven results improving first-pass yield, reducing Cost of Poor Quality and warranty costs, and strengthening customer satisfaction.
* Strong working knowledge of root cause analysis, CAPA, 8D, FMEA, statistical process control, process capability and measurement system analysis.
* Ability to develop people, lead organizational training and influence cross-functional teams; strong judgment, clear communication and a customer-focused approach.
* Experience translating business priorities into plans, budgets, resource decisions and measurable performance goals.
* Demonstrated ability to modernize quality processes using digital tools, analytics or automation, with curiosity and practical judgment about applying AI.

**Preferred Qualifications**
============================

* Experience with industrial fire and gas detection, life safety products, instrumentation, electronics or electromechanical manufacturing.
* Familiarity with product certification, functional safety and approval agency requirements relevant to industrial safety products.
* Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt, ASQ quality certification, or comparable demonstrated expertise.
* Experience with APQP, PPAP, first article inspection, supplier audits and quality planning for new products.
* Experience supporting global customers or suppliers and using ERP systems, Minitab, Excel or Power BI for quality analysis and reporting.
* Experience implementing digital QMS workflows, automated dashboards or AI-enabled quality improvements, with measurable benefits and effective user adoption.

**Why Join Det-Tronics**
========================

Bring your ideas, curiosity and leadership to products that help protect lives. Work directly with senior leaders and technical teams to build skills across the organization, experiment with better ways of working and turn digital tools into meaningful improvements. This is an opportunity to make quality simpler, smarter and more engaging—and help others do the same.

existing_roles.title: Corporate Food Safety Quality Assurance Director
existing_roles.description:
**We are willing to relocate to Rhode Island area for the right candidate**

We are seeking an experienced and detail-oriented Corporate Food Safety Quality Assurance Director to lead our food safety and quality assurance programs. The Director will be responsible for ensuring the highest standards of food safety and quality across all operations, developing and implementing policies, and managing compliance with regulatory requirements. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in food safety and quality assurance, with excellent leadership and analytical skills.

### **Duties/Responsibilities:**

* Develop and implement comprehensive food safety programs to ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and industry standards.

* Oversee quality assurance processes, including product testing, inspections, and audits to maintain high-quality standards.

* Create and enforce food safety and quality policies and procedures across all operations.

* Ensure compliance with local, state, and federal food safety regulations, including FDA, USDA, and HACCP standards.

* Identify and manage food safety risks, implementing corrective actions and preventive measures.

* Develop and deliver training programs to educate employees on food safety and quality assurance practices.

* Monitor and analyze food safety and quality metrics to identify areas for improvement and implement the best practices.

* Lead and mentor the food safety and quality assurance team, fostering a collaborative and high-performance work environment.

* Build and maintain strong relationships with stakeholders, including suppliers, customers, and regulatory agencies.

### **Required Skills/Abilities:**

* Exceptional leadership skills with the ability to inspire and motivate a diverse team.

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to effectively convey complex food safety information.

* Strong attention to detail and accuracy in food safety and quality assurance processes.

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to make data-driven decisions.

* Excellent organizational and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

* Proficiency with food safety and quality assurance software, systems, and Microsoft Office Suite.

### **Education and Experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree in food science, Microbiology, or a related field is required.

* Master's degree or relevant certification (e.g., HACCP, SQF, PCQI) is highly preferred.

* A minimum of 10 years of experience in food safety and quality assurance roles, with a proven track record of success.

* Extensive experience with food safety regulations, standards, and compliance.
* Proven ability to lead and develop high-performing teams.

### **Working Conditions:**

* Ability to work flexible hours, including evenings and weekends as needed.

* Availability for occasional travel to meet with stakeholders and attend industry events.

* Ability to thrive in a high-pressure environment and make critical food safety decisions under stress.

* Flexibility to work remotely, when necessary, while maintaining effective communication and oversight.

* Willingness to work extended hours during peak business periods or crises.

* Managing food safety and quality assurance operations across multiple time zones and cultures, requiring adaptability and cultural sensitivity.

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. existing_roles.title: Sr. Program Director III - Quality & Customer Success (6900)
existing_roles.description:
As **Sr.** **Program Director III - Quality & Customer Success**, you'll report directly to the Executive Vice President of the Intelligence Portfolio. This role oversees quality assurance and customer success. The Program Director removes delivery impediments, strengthens collaboration across teams, ensures compliance with contract requirements, and advocates for successful customer outcomes.

We know that you can't have great technology services without amazing people. At MetroStar, we are **obsessed** withour people and have led a two-decade legacy of building the best and brightest teams. Because we know our future relies on our deep understanding and relentless focus on our people, we live by our mission: A passion for our people. Value for our customers.

If you think you can see yourself delivering our mission and pursuing our goals with us, then check out the job description below!

**What you'll do:**

* Constantly monitor project progress to identify impediments early on, actively engage in resolving them, and 
 escalate issues when necessary.
* Manage and track dependencies across cross-functional teams or squads to ensure seamless collaboration and 
 timely delivery.
* Oversee and track all high-integrity commitments, ensuring they are met according to established timelines and 
 standards.
* Provide proactive visibility into project status, communicate delivery targets, commitments, and progress 
 effectively to stakeholders.
* Define, implement, and administer program deliverables to ensure full compliance with contract requirements. 
 Regularly report progress on problem resolution to senior management, highlighting any critical issues or 
 roadblocks.
* Foster a culture of team-driven decision-making and commitment, promoting trust among team members and 
 facilitating team-building events.
* Support customer meeting preparation and delivery and assist with escalations.
* Perform any other duties as assigned by senior leadership to support the overall objectives of the organization

**What you'll need to succeed:**

 

* Active TS//SCI with ability to obtain CI poly
* Bachelor's degree in a relevant field.
* 10+ years of quality assurance experience, including at least 5 years in a leadership role.
* Proven success implementing and managing quality assurance processes and practices.
* Strong understanding of software development methodologies and quality assurance principles.
* Demonstrated ability to identify and resolve delivery impediments, manage dependencies across teams, and escalate critical issues.
* Experience overseeing program deliverables to ensure compliance with contract requirements, timelines, and quality standards.
* Ability to track commitments and clearly communicate project status, delivery targets, risks, and resolution progress to stakeholders and senior leadership.

existing_roles.title: Quality Management Director
existing_roles.description:
**Overview**

The Quality Management Director develops, implements, and maintains the hospital's Quality Management System in line with ISO 9001 and NIAHO standards. The director oversees the Quality Assurance/Performance Improvement (QAPI) program and keeps the hospital compliant with CMS Conditions of Participation and state requirements. The role leads survey and accreditation readiness, including mock surveys, tracers, and plans of correction. The director chairs or coordinates the quality committees, supervises the Quality and Compliance Associate, and monitors regulatory quality requirements. The director also oversees quality and patient safety data reporting, including dashboards and benchmarking, presented to the Medical Staff, Executive Leadership, and Board.

I. Minimum Qualifications:

A. Education:

1. Current licensure to practice as a Registered Professional Nurse in the State of Texas or equivalent degree in healthcare with a minimum of a baccalaureate degree. Master's degree in nursing, healthcare administration, quality management, or a related healthcare field preferred.

2. Lean Six Sigma certification (Green Belt or higher) preferred.

3. Must have at least three (3) years of experience in management or quality improvement in an accredited acute care setting.

II. Knowledge and Skills:

1. Demonstrate knowledge and leadership skills to perform duties outlined in the job description

1. Must have strong knowledge of accrediting and regulatory agency requirements

2. Must have good problem solving, interpersonal communication and project management skills

3. Must be extremely detail-oriented with respect to documentation and communication

4. Able to read and interpret medical record documentation and hospital policies and procedures

5. Must have at a minimum proficient computer skills in using Microsoft computer programs (Word, Excel, PPT, etc.)

III. Personal/Physical Requirements:

1. Mental and physical health to meet demands of position

2. Must have respect for human dignity and cultural diversity

3. Demonstrates ability in use of verbal/written communication, and effectively communicate with patients, families, hospital staff, medical staff, and general public.

IV. Data Reporting Requirements:

1. Oversees and supports the data collection, validation, analysis, and submits required quality and patient safety data to regulatory, accrediting, and governmental agencies (e.g., CMS, Texas Health and Human Services, and the hospital's accrediting organization) within required timeframes, including all mandatory quality reporting program measures applicable to a rural hospital.

2. Ensures accuracy, completeness, and integrity of abstracted and reported data through routine audits, validation processes, and corrective action when discrepancies are identified.

3. Prepares and presents routine quality dashboards, scorecards, and trend analyses to the Quality Committee, Medical Staff, Executive Leadership, and Board of Directors, at least quarterly or as required.

4. Benchmarks hospital performance against state, regional, and national comparative data and identifies opportunities for improvement.

5. Maintains confidentiality of patient, and quality data in accordance with HIPAA, and hospital policy, and retains all reports and supporting documentation per record retention requirements.

V. Oversight Responsibilities:

1. Provides oversight of the hospital-wide Quality Management System, including the Quality Assurance/Performance Improvement (QAPI) program, and ensures ongoing compliance with ISO 9001, NIAHO, CMS Conditions of Participation, and applicable state requirements.

2. Oversees survey and accreditation readiness, including mock surveys, tracer activities, and the development, implementation, and monitoring of plans of correction following internal or external surveys.

3. Oversees the work of the Quality and Compliance Associate.

4. Leads and monitors performance improvement projects, applying Lean Six Sigma and other process improvement methodologies, and tracks project outcomes and sustainability.

5. Chairs or coordinates quality committees, ensures committee minutes, action items, and follow-up are documented, and reports quality oversight activities to the Chief Executive Officer and the governing body.

Pay: From $85,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* AD&D insurance
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Retirement plan
* Tuition reimbursement
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

existing_roles.title: Director of Quality
existing_roles.description:
**Director of Quality**

**Location**

Carmel, IN • Memphis, TN • St. Louis, MO • Malden, MO • Peoria, IL • Other Illinois locations

**Leadership**

Directly manages at least two quality team members

**Travel**

Regular travel to manufacturing facilities and business locations, as needed

Weaver Popcorn is seeking a seasoned quality leader ready to step into a broader Director-level role. The Director of Quality provides strategic and operational leadership for food safety, quality assurance, regulatory compliance, audit readiness, and continuous improvement across the organization’s food manufacturing operations. This leader will strengthen and standardize quality systems, develop quality talent, and partner with plant and business leaders to ensure products consistently meet company, customer, certification, and regulatory requirements.

This is a hands-on leadership role for an experienced food manufacturing quality professional who can set direction while remaining actively engaged with plant teams, audits, investigations, corrective actions, and day-to-day execution.

**HOW WILL YOU HELP US GROW?**
==============================

**Quality & Food Safety Leadership**
------------------------------------

* Develop and lead the company’s quality and food safety strategy, priorities, policies, procedures, and performance expectations across manufacturing locations.
* Ensure quality assurance and food safety programs are effectively implemented, maintained, verified, and continuously improved.
* Establish and oversee grain and popcorn quality standards from grower receipt and bulk storage through processing, bagging, and shipment, ensuring consistent quality controls throughout the supply chain.
* Provide visible leadership on the manufacturing floor through routine plant engagement, risk reviews, verification activities, and follow-up on quality concerns.
* Build a culture of accountability, prevention, compliance, and continuous improvement across Quality, Operations, Supply Chain, Sales, and other partner functions.

**SQF, Audits & Regulatory Compliance**
---------------------------------------

* Lead and maintain SQF certification programs, including system ownership, audit preparation, certification readiness, corrective actions, and ongoing compliance.
* Plan, lead, and oversee internal, customer, certification, and regulatory audits of food manufacturing facilities.
* Ensure timely closure of audit findings, nonconformances, corrective and preventive actions, and related verification activities.
* Lead cross-functional Food Safety/HACCP, risk assessment, prerequisite program, and food quality teams.
* Monitor applicable food safety and quality requirements and translate them into practical operating standards and controls.
* Ensure effective quality controls for bulk grain storage, bin holds and releases, sampling, testing, and corn disposition prior to processing, including compliance with applicable phytosanitary requirements.

**Quality Management Systems**
------------------------------

* Own the effective use and continuous improvement of quality management system software, including document control, audits, corrective actions, training records, verification, and reporting.
* Standardize quality documentation, specifications, procedures, policies, records, and reporting across facilities.
* Use quality data, trend analysis, and leading and lagging indicators to identify risk, establish priorities, and improve performance.
* Ensure effective controls for ingredient sampling, product verification, environmental monitoring, sanitation verification, traceability, and other core quality programs.
* Provide oversight of corn testing and laboratory quality programs, including mycotoxin testing, internal and third-party sample testing, review of test results, and appropriate product disposition based on quality and food safety requirements.

**People Leadership & Cross-Functional Partnership**
----------------------------------------------------

* Lead, coach, and develop a quality team of at least two direct reports, with potential for broader team responsibility as the function grows.
* Set clear goals, define accountabilities, assess performance, strengthen technical capability, and create development plans for quality team members.
* Partner with Plant Managers and Operations leaders to resolve quality issues without compromising food safety, customer requirements, or regulatory compliance.
* Establish and enforce hold/release and product disposition standards, with authority to stop processing or bagging operations and place grain, ingredients, or finished product on hold when food safety or quality requirements are not met.
* Partner with Sales and Customer Service to respond to customer documentation requests, audits, samples, complaints, and quality-related inquiries.
* Lead investigations into customer complaints, product or process deviations, and recurring issues; ensure root cause analysis and sustainable corrective action.
* Oversee nonconforming material, product holds, rework, release, and disposition processes, partnering with Operations and suppliers to ensure timely resolution and prevent recurrence.
* Provide clear quality updates, risk assessments, recommendations, and performance reporting to senior leadership and other decision-makers.

**WHAT DO YOU NEED TO HAVE?**
=============================

* Bachelor's degree in food science, Food Safety, Microbiology, Chemistry, Biology, Engineering, or related fields.
* 8–10+ years of progressive quality or food safety experience in the food manufacturing industry.
* At least 5 years of people-management experience, including progressive supervisory and manager-level responsibility.
* Proven leadership of SQF certification programs and successful food manufacturing audits.
* Demonstrated knowledge of food safety principles, quality assurance procedures and policies, HACCP-based programs, risk assessment, corrective action, and preventive controls.
* Experience leading internal, customer, certification, and/or regulatory audits across food manufacturing environments.
* Hands-on experience with quality management system software and electronic quality records.
* Demonstrated ability to lead through influence, develop teams, manage competing priorities, and drive consistent execution across locations.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate quality risk and technical requirements to operational and executive audiences.
* Ability to travel regularly to manufacturing facilities and business locations, as needed.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience in grain, corn, popcorn, milling, ingredient, or related agricultural processing.
* SQF Practitioner experience and formal training in HACCP, PCQI, internal auditing, root cause analysis, or preventive controls.
* Experience supporting multiple manufacturing sites or standardizing quality systems across locations.
* Experience with supplier quality, customer complaint management, environmental monitoring, traceability, recall readiness, and food defense programs.

**WHAT DOES SUCCESS LOOK LIKE?**
================================

* Consistent audit and certification readiness across facilities.
* Stronger standardization and adoption of quality systems, procedures, and records.
* Timely, well-documented corrective action with verified effectiveness.
* Reduced recurrence of quality issues and customer complaints through disciplined root cause analysis.
* A capable, accountable quality team with clear goals and development plans.
* Credible, practical partnership with Operations and business leaders while maintaining independent quality judgment.

**WORK ENVIRONMENT & SCHEDULE**
===============================

This role operates across office and food manufacturing environments and requires regular presence in production areas. The typical schedule is Monday through Friday; however, the Director of Quality must be available outside normal business hours, including occasional evenings or weekends, when operational, audit, customer, or food safety needs require support. Regular travel is expected based on business needs.

**HOW WILL WE HELP YOU GROW?**
==============================

* Competitive compensation.
* Three weeks of paid time off in the first year.
* 401(k) plan with a company match of 100% of employee deferrals up to 10%.
* Health, vision, dental, life, and disability insurance beginning the first day of the month following 30 days of employment.
* Education reimbursement of up to $15,000 per year.

**EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY**
================================

Weaver Popcorn is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and associates. Employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business needs, without regard to any status protected by applicable law.

*The role responsibilities are many, various, and not limited to those written in this document*

We move fast, think big, and combine start-up agility with aerospace expertise to design, build, and scale aircraft in ways the industry has never seen. Our team leverages automation, AI-driven tools, and a fully connected digital backbone to accelerate innovation and reduce barriers to production.*

*Here, you won't just take a job — you'll help reinvent how the world flies. If you're ready to solve complex problems, push technology further, and work alongside some of the brightest minds in aerospace, this is your chance to make a real impact.*

Neon is looking for an Aerospace Quality Director to help build the quality systems, team, and operating discipline needed to take parts and assemblies from prototype into production. This role will lead the quality function across development, manufacturing, supplier quality, and production readiness, ensuring the company can scale with strong process control, repeatability, and compliance. You will play a key role in helping a growing aerospace organization move from fast iteration to reliable production without losing technical rigor.

### **Why This Role Matters**

* Help shape how a growing company scales from prototype builds to stable production.
* Build the quality foundation needed for repeatable manufacturing, stronger yields, and fewer escapes.
* Partner directly with engineering and manufacturing to improve design transfer, process readiness, and production execution.
* Lead the systems and team that drive inspection discipline, nonconformance control, corrective action, and supplier quality.
* Influence how production processes are defined, controlled, and improved as volume and complexity grow.
* Operate in a fast-paced environment where quality decisions directly affect hardware readiness, customer confidence, and operational scale.
* Work across office, lab, and production settings with direct visibility into how quality impacts the business.

### **What You'll Bring**

* Bachelor's degree in engineering, quality, manufacturing, aerospace, or a related technical field; equivalent professional experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.
* Experience managing a growing department of direct reports responsible for all aspects of product and process quality.
* Significant progressive experience in aerospace quality, manufacturing quality, supplier quality, or quality systems leadership.
* Experience helping move parts, assemblies, or hardware programs from prototype into production.
* Experience building or improving quality systems in a growing manufacturing organization.
* Strong background in inspection planning, process controls, nonconformance management, and corrective action.
* Experience working cross-functionally with engineering, manufacturing, and supply chain teams to improve quality and production readiness.
* Experience with supplier quality management and supplier issue resolution.
* Strong problem-solving skills, judgment, communication, and ability to drive accountability across teams.
* Ability to work across office, lab, and production environments.
* Ability to support periods of increased workload tied to builds, ramp activity, and issue resolution.
* Must be legally authorized to work in the United States.
* May be required to meet export control, ITAR, confidentiality, or site access requirements.

#### **Preferred**

* Advanced degree in a relevant technical discipline; equivalent professional experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.
* ASQ certification or equivalent quality credential.
* Experience with first article inspection, process validation, control plans, or production quality planning tools.
* Experience in high-growth aerospace, defense, or advanced hardware manufacturing environments.
* Experience building quality organizations during production scale-up.

### **Why Join Us**

* Work alongside elite engineering talent and innovators from across aerospace and tech.
* Be part of a team moving faster than the industry standard.
* Shape solutions that are lower-cost, autonomous, and scalable — the future of aviation.
* Competitive compensation, including equity participation, growth opportunities, and full health benefits (health, vision, dental, 401(k)) designed to support you in and out of work.

*Neon Aero, Inc is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected status under applicable law.*

existing_roles.title: Senior Director, Quality Control
existing_roles.description:
ElevateBio is a technology-driven company powering the industry forward by helping partners realize the potential of their therapies from design to commercialization. We have integrated a differentiated set of technologies, end-to-end services, and industry-leading manufacturing expertise to develop advanced therapies faster and more efficiently.

 

**The Role**

The Senior Director, Quality Control leads all Quality Control operations at ElevateBio's Waltham site, including QC Analytical Technologies (QCAT), QC Analytics, Testing Core, QC Microbiology, QC Raw Materials, and QC Logistics. The role is accountable for safe, compliant, inspection-ready, and predictable execution across a seven-day operating model, including product release and in-process testing, STAT support to Manufacturing, environmental and microbiological testing, raw material disposition, stability support, sample management, and analytical lifecycle enablement. The Senior Director establishes the QC operating strategy, capacity and resource plan, performance system, and leadership model required to meet manufacturing, client, and business commitments while sustaining laboratory excellence and data integrity.

**Here's What You'll Do**

**QC Strategy and Leadership**

* Lead the integrated QC organization, operating model, objectives, decision rights, talent strategy, and capability roadmap.
* Develop QC management and technical leaders while aligning headcount, seven-day coverage, facilities, equipment, systems, operating expense, and capital with demand.

**Predictable QC Operations and Laboratory Excellence**

* Own safe, compliant, and predictable execution of product release and in-process testing, environmental and microbiological monitoring, raw material disposition, stability, sample management, and client commitments.
* Ensure reliable seven-day operations through capacity planning, schedule control, tiered daily management, performance review, and timely escalation and recovery.
* Partner with Manufacturing to align readiness, prioritization, and rapid execution of STAT in-process samples within required decision windows.
* Drive laboratory excellence through standard work, right-first-time execution, efficient review and reporting, backlog control, structured problem solving, and continuous improvement.

**Analytical Technologies and Lifecycle Enablement**

* Provide leadership oversight for QCAT, including client technical interface, technology and method transfer, qualification and validation, method lifecycle management, equipment qualification, controls and critical reagents, and Digital QC.
* Ensure effective utilization of shared QC Resources, handoffs between QCAT and operational laboratories through clear readiness criteria, accountability, sustainable capacity, and post-implementation monitoring.

**Quality, Compliance, and Partnership**

* Ensure QC activities meet cGMP, approved procedures, specifications, quality agreements, data-integrity expectations, and regulatory commitments.
* Provide senior oversight of laboratory events, atypical or out-of-specification results, deviations, investigations, CAPAs, changes, risks, and inspection readiness.
* Represent QC in client governance, audits, regulatory inspections, release-readiness reviews, and escalations; communicate performance, constraints, risks, and recovery plans clearly.
* Serve as the senior QC partner to Manufacturing, Quality Assurance, Facilities & Engineering, MSAT, Regulatory Affairs, Supply Chain, Digital, Process and Analytical Development, and site leadership.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Biology, Microbiology, Biochemistry, Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Engineering, or a related scientific discipline; an advanced degree is preferred.
* At least 15 years of progressive experience in GMP Quality Control or analytical laboratory operations, including substantial leadership of managers and multi-functional teams.
* Demonstrated leadership of a broad QC organization supporting complex biopharmaceutical, biologics, cell therapy, gene therapy, or other regulated manufacturing operations.
* Strong knowledge of GMP laboratory controls, analytical testing, microbiology, environmental monitoring, raw materials, stability, sample management, analytical lifecycle activities, laboratory systems, data integrity, contract laboratory oversight, and quality systems.
* Demonstrated success improving schedule reliability, turnaround time, right-first-time performance, capacity utilization, investigation management, and inspection readiness.

existing_roles.description:
**Position Title:** Director of Quality Assurance

**Department/Area:** Quality Assurance

**Reports to:** Senior Director of Quality Assurance

**Employment Status:** Full-Time; Non-Union

**EXCELLENT BENEFITS PACKAGE:**

* **Earn an additional week of paid time off including floating holidays, and personal time! Plus,**
* **13 paid holidays per year, and paid sick time!**
* **Company paid Life Insurance,**
* **Company paid Accidental Death & Dismemberment Insurance,**
* **401K,**
* **Opt-in benefits available: Pet Insurance, Employee/Spouse/Child Life Insurance, and Long Term Disability,**
* **Plus, Medical, Dental, & Vision Insurance!**

 

**Organization Overview:**

Sound Community Services, Inc. (SCSI) is a private, not-for-profit organization dedicated to educating, assisting, and supporting individuals with persistent mental illness and substance use disorders. We work tirelessly to create a culture and environment in which recovery and wellness are possible.

**Position Overview:**

The Director of Quality Assurance (QA) oversees all agency activities related to quality improvement, compliance, data integrity, and regulatory preparedness for the agency. This position provides leadership in the development, implementation, and monitoring of systems that support clinical excellence, consumer rights, performance measurement, and regulatory compliance. The Director plays a critical role in the maintenance, configuration, and optimization of the Electronic Health Record (EHR); oversees required state reporting; maintains the centralized repository of all Department of Mental Health and Addiction Services (DMHAS) reported data; and ensures accurate and timely data submission. This role also leads the agency’s preparation for external audits (ex., Commission on Accreditation of Rehabilitation Facilities (CARF), Department of Public Health (DPH), DMHAS), coordinates customer satisfaction activities, and serves as the agency’s Client Rights Officer.

This position is responsible for the monitoring and analyzing of processes to meet Fidelity and contractual requirements across the agency. Ongoing analysis of health care information obtained from a variety of sources, including patient care, financial, and demographic data is necessary. This role involves the development and preparation of information for state reporting and organizational best practices. This position will maintain repository of all state reported data for all DMHAS programs. A heavy importance is placed on collaborating with program leaders across the agency, ensuring accuracy of data reported and driving agency performance.

**Essential Functions**

**Department Leadership, Training, and Support**

* Directly supervise two (2) employees in the Quality Assurance department and serve as backup to staff as needed.
* Provide Daily Living Activities Functional Assessment (DLA-20), program specific documentation, and recovery planning training to the agency.
* Train employees and monitor compliance across programs with state reporting requirements.
* Function as an internal information expert to the entire management team when special and critical quality issues occur.
* Consult with senior leadership to resolve quality, service, and efficiency problems.

**State Reporting, Data, and Surveys**

* Facilitate and coordinate annual DMHAS Consumer Satisfaction Surveys and quarterly CARF Satisfaction surveys.
* Provide DMHAS Data Performance System (DDaP) data and informational support to other departments, including DDaP 101 supervisor training, share DMHAS information with leadership, and present quarterly and annual DMHAS Report Cards to leadership.

**Electronic Health Record (EHR) and Systems Support**

* Triage QA tickets. Issues include, but are not limited to, document management, on/off-boarding, medical staff onboarding, system outages, etc.
* Facilitate within the EHR the build and support of procedures, forms, and form development; implement training to identified employees.
* Foster ongoing support to assigned programs and serve as a liaison between staff and vendors for effective responses to users’ needs.

**Audit Readiness, Compliance, and Quality Improvement**

* Provide support to programs in preparation for routine external audits, including CARF survey, fidelity reviews, and Department of Public Health licensing.
* Facilitate completion of all corrective action plans and audit follow-up, including quarterly and annual program compliance reviews.
* Monitor and assist with corrections and work with programs to identify and resolve root causes as needed.
* Ensure compliance with SCSI’s policies, quality assurance programs, and safety; ensure EHR compliance with regulatory agencies like DMHAS, DPH, CARF, etc.
* Participate in quality improvement initiatives.
* Serve as the agency’s Client Rights Officer (CRO), observing and adhering to the role outlined by DMHAS.

**Agency Participation and Policy Compliance**

* Participate in all agency activities pertaining to health and safety, training, drills, etc.
* Adhere to SCSI policies and procedures.

**Physical Requirements**

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit, use hands to finger, handle or feel objects, tools, or controls, and climb stairs. The employee frequently is required to walk, talk and/or hear; speaking and hearing ability sufficient to communicate effectively by phone or in person at normal volumes; vision adequate to read correspondence, computer screen, forms, etc. The employee is occasionally required to stand and climb or balance. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 lbs. Specific vision abilities required by this position include the ability to adjust focus. The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**

* Strong understanding of Connecticut DMHAS standards, documentation requirements, and reporting systems (including DDaP).
* Demonstrated ability to supervise, lead, and coach staff.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data, identify trends, and communicate findings clearly.
* Demonstrated technology and software application skills; ability to learn new software packages; highly skilled in office productivity software (e.g., Word, PowerPoint, Excel, email).
* Excellent written and oral communication skills.
* Ability to be proactive, flexible, and customer service focused and to work effectively with others.

**Qualifications**

**Minimum education:** Bachelor’s degree required, or an equivalent combination of education and related experience.

**Minimum experience:** Experience working with electronic health record system, i.e., CareLogic; experience providing training; and experience with accreditation standards such as CARF, DMHAS, DPH, or similar regulatory bodies.

**Preferred qualifications:** Bachelor’s degree in Public Health, Social Work, Psychology, Healthcare Administration, or a related field. Masters degree preferred.

**Preferred license:** Licensed Clinical Social Worker (LCSW) or Licensed Professional Counselor (LPC)

**Driver’s license requirement:** A current valid driver’s license is required.

**Background check, credentialing, health screening, or other employment requirements:** Successful completion of required background checks and any other applicable agency employment requirements.

**Equal Employment Opportunity Statement**

Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religious creed, age, sex, pregnancy, gender identity or expression, marital status, civil union status, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, present or past history of mental disability, intellectual disability, learning disability, physical disability, including but not limited to blindness, genetic information, veteran status, sexual orientation, status as a victim of domestic violence, status as a victim of sexual assault, status as a victim of trafficking in persons, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

**Other Duties**

This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work performed by individuals assigned to this position. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or qualifications. Employees may be required to perform other job-related duties as assigned.
