Plant Manager – Plastics Manufacturing

We are recruiting for an experienced **Plant Manager** to lead operations at an established plastics packaging manufacturing facility.

This opportunity is ideal for a hands-on manufacturing leader with experience in **injection molding, blow molding, extrusion, or thermoforming**, who can drive operational performance, develop teams, and improve plant profitability.

Responsibilities

* Manage daily plant operations, including production, maintenance, and quality.
* Lead and develop production managers, supervisors, and manufacturing teams.
* Improve productivity, OEE, scrap rates, and manufacturing efficiency.
* Drive Lean Manufacturing and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Manage plant budgets, labor costs, and operational performance.
* Ensure production targets, quality standards, and delivery schedules are achieved.
* Reduce equipment downtime and improve plant reliability.
* Maintain a safe working environment and ensure OSHA compliance.
* Report plant KPIs and operational performance to senior leadership.

Requirements

* Previous experience as a Plant Manager or senior Operations Manager within manufacturing.
* **Plastics or plastic packaging manufacturing experience is essential.**
* Knowledge of injection molding, blow molding, extrusion, or thermoforming.
* Proven experience managing production teams and multi-shift operations.
* Strong understanding of Lean Manufacturing, OEE, and continuous improvement.
* Experience managing budgets, costs, and plant performance.
* Excellent leadership, communication, and problem-solving skills.

Salary & Benefits

* **$130,000 – $160,000 annual base salary**
* Full-time, permanent position
* Senior leadership opportunity
* Established manufacturing environment
* Long-term career progression

Apply Now

If you're an experienced Plant Manager with a background in plastics packaging manufacturing, apply today for a confidential discussion about this opportunity.

Candidates must be eligible to work and live in the United States without restriction

Pay: $130,000.00 - $160,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

* What salary would you be looking for to start a new role?
* What are your reasons for looking to leave your current employer?

existing_roles.description:
**Role Description:**

The Plant Manager is responsible for the management, planning, and coordination of all precast manufacturing operations to meet DVP business goals, while providing leadership to all plant and yard personnel.

**General Supervisory Responsibilities and Duties:**

* Create and manage production schedules based on manpower, customer demand, and DVP business goals
* Meet with General Manager as needed to review any safety concerns, production & quality issues, personnel needs, and inventory levels
* Conducts daily supervisor meetings to discuss production schedules, concerns, opportunities for improvement and to ensure ongoing organizational teamwork
* Hold monthly plant safety meetings and review any safety related deficiencies and submit recommendations to DVP senior management
* Track key performance metrics and hold direct reports accountable for results
* Ensure all production and yard operations meet DVP quality control standards
* Track and manage the inventory levels of finished goods
* Oversee and manage all incoming materials to ensure adequate inventory levels are met
* Continually collect and review data to reduce inefficiencies and waste
* Successfully hire, supervise, train, and retain production/yard staff
* Evaluate and review employee’s performance for the purpose of determining skill level and training needs
* Coach and mentor employees to allow for increased responsibilities and career advancement. Lead by example.
* Promote and maintain a clean work environment
* Recommend purchases of additional equipment for efficiency, cost reductions and/or quality improvements
* Successfully work with Quality Control/Project Management to meet customer demand and expectations
* Perform any other duties as assigned by the General Manager

**Supervisory Responsibilities:**

* Supervision of Plant Supervisors
* Leading by example, create and sustain a safe working environment for the facility

**Required Skills/Abilities:**

* Eligible to work in the U.S
* Successful experience in precast plant management
* Ability to read contract documents, engineering specifications and drawings
* Strong interpersonal and leadership skills
* Excellent time management skills
* Highly organized and self-motivated
* Strong oral and written communication skills
* Work with computer as necessary (Microsoft Word, Excel)

**Physical Requirements:**

* Standing and walking for extended periods of time
* Exposure to fluctuating weather conditions including extreme cold or heat
* Must be in good physical and mental health

**Education and Experience:**

* 10+ years of precast concrete experience
* 5+ years production supervision or related experience

**Benefits:**

* Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* Simple IRA with a Company Match
* Paid Time-off

Benefit Conditions:

* 60-Day waiting period
* Only full-time employees eligible

**Schedule:**

* Monday through Friday, minimum 45 hrs. Overtime & weekends may be required to meet project schedules.

**Pay Range:** Commensurate with experience

Pay: $95,000.00 - $120,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Relocation assistance
* Vision insurance

Plant Manager – Level 3 Water Treatment PlantNorth Greene Utilities (NGU)Baileyton, Tennessee

North Greene Utilities is seeking a certified Level 3 Water Treatment Plant Manager to lead operations at our Level 3 water treatment production plant in Baileyton Tennessee. This is a key leadership role responsible for the full management of plant functions, regulatory compliance, and a small team of operators.

Position Overview

The Plant Manager oversees all day-to-day and long-term operations of NGU’s Level 3 water treatment plant. The position ensures continuous production of safe, high-quality water that meets or exceeds all Tennessee Department of Environment and Conservation (TDEC) and U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) standards and guidance. The manager supervises, mentors, and develops a team of three subordinates while maintaining efficient, safe, and compliant plant operations.

Key Responsibilities

* Manage all plant functions and treatment processes to meet TDEC and EPA regulatory requirements and policy guidance.• Supervise, mentor, and train three subordinates. Two subordinates are expected to achieve Level 1 certification by mid-2027.• Develop, implement, and manage shift schedules to ensure continuous, reliable plant coverage.• Ensure compliance with all federal and state safety regulations and NGU safety protocols.• Conduct lifecycle and operational management of treatment infrastructure, including maintenance planning and capital needs.• Participate in daily stand-up meetings with the NGU management team.• Assist with HR requirements for subordinates, including ensuring compliance with company policies.• Monitor the health and welfare of subordinates.• Conduct biannual performance counseling for subordinates.• Demonstrate flexibility and adaptability to evolving operational requirements and tasks as directed by the Operations Supervisor and General Manager.• Maintain accurate records, reporting, and documentation required for regulatory compliance and internal management.

Qualifications

* Current Tennessee Level 3 Water Treatment Operator certification (required).• Proven experience in water treatment plant operations, preferably in a leadership or supervisory role.• Strong knowledge of TDEC and EPA drinking water regulations, treatment processes, and compliance requirements.• Ability to supervise, train, and develop staff.• Valid driver’s license and ability to meet any additional job-related certifications or requirements (e.g., safety, drug and alcohol screening).• Excellent communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills.• Commitment to safety, regulatory compliance, and continuous improvement.

Compensation and Benefits

NGU offers very competitive wages, an IRA, health insurance, and dental coverage. Additional details on pay and benefits will be discussed with qualified candidates.

How to Apply

Interested candidates should submit a resume, copy of current Level 3 certification, and contact information to .

For questions, contact the office at 423-234-3145.

North Greene Utilities is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to providing reliable water service to our customers while supporting the professional growth of our team.

Pay: $25.00 - $30.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Retirement plan
* Vision insurance

**Job Summary**
---------------

**Fresh & Ready Foods** is seeking a strategic and hands-on **Operations Director** to lead our Longview, TX manufacturing facility. As the site leader, this role is responsible for overseeing all aspects of production, food safety, quality, maintenance, warehousing, and distribution while driving operational excellence and developing high-performing teams.

Reporting to the Regional Director, the Operations Director will be accountable for achieving safety, quality, service, inventory, and financial objectives while fostering a culture of continuous improvement and employee engagement. This highly visible leadership role requires a strong manufacturing background, a passion for people development, and the ability to drive results in a fast-paced food production environment.

#### 

#### **Key Responsibilities**

* Provide overall leadership for plant operations, including production, quality, food safety, maintenance, warehousing, and distribution.
* Lead and develop managers, supervisors, and frontline teams to create a strong culture of accountability, engagement, and performance.
* Champion safety, regulatory compliance, and food safety programs, including SQF, HACCP, sanitation, and audit readiness.
* Drive Lean Manufacturing and continuous improvement initiatives to improve productivity, reduce waste, and optimize plant performance.
* Establish and manage KPIs related to safety, quality, labor, yield, inventory, customer service, and on-time delivery.
* Partner with cross-functional teams to support customer growth, new product introductions, and operational initiatives.
* Manage budgets, labor costs, inventory levels, and operational expenses to achieve financial objectives.
* Maintain a visible presence on the production floor, coaching leaders and supporting problem-solving efforts.
* Build succession plans and develop future leaders within the organization.
* Foster a culture focused on operational excellence, customer satisfaction, and continuous improvement.

#### 

#### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Operations, Engineering, Business, Food Science, Supply Chain, or related field preferred.
* 7+ years of progressive leadership experience in food manufacturing, beverage manufacturing, CPG, protein processing, bakery, prepared foods, or related manufacturing environments.
* Experience managing large production teams through multiple levels of leadership.
* Strong knowledge of Lean Manufacturing, Continuous Improvement, Six Sigma, TPS, or similar methodologies.
* Proven track record improving safety, quality, productivity, and financial performance.
* Experience with SQF, HACCP, FDA/USDA regulations, sanitation programs, and quality systems.
* Strong financial acumen, including budgeting, labor management, inventory control, and operational reporting.
* Excellent communication, coaching, and leadership skills.

#### 

#### **Ideal Candidate**

The ideal candidate is a visible, people-focused manufacturing leader who enjoys building teams, developing talent, and driving operational results. They possess strong food manufacturing experience, a continuous improvement mindset, and a proven ability to lead large-scale operations while improving safety, quality, service, and profitability. Experience in high-volume food production environments is strongly preferred.

existing_roles.title: Vice President, Quality & Food Safety
existing_roles.description:
Description:

**Who We Are**

Headquartered in Vineland, NJ, F&S Fresh Foods is leading the way in fresh-cut fruit, vegetables, and meal solutions distribution. With the recent acquisition of five additional state-of-the-art facilities strategically located across the U.S., we now deliver to customers across the United States and Canada — every single day!

For over 40 years, we’ve been redefining production and safety processes, building strong partnerships, and creating endless possibilities for our diverse customers — from restaurants and supermarket prepared food operations to convenience store chains and beyond. At F&S, we are fueling families with nutrition, innovation, and convenience, turning meals into memorable moments. By combining cutting-edge technology, deep-rooted customer relationships, and operational excellence, we are shaping the future of fresh — from farm to family.

We’re not just about food; we’re about people. Recognized as a Great Place to Work for three consecutive years, our team of 2,100 full-time employees drives our culture forward by living our values every day. If you’re ready to be part of a company that values innovation, excellence, and community impact, join us as we embrace our next exciting chapter of growth. Together, we’re planting the seeds of progress and nourishing a fresh, healthy future for everyone!

**What We Offer**

* Competitive compensation package
* Comprehensive benefits: Medical, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance
* 401(K) including company match!
* Paid Time Off annually + Paid Holidays
* Career Advancement opportunities and Tuition Assistance

**What’s the Role**

The Vice President, Quality & Food Safety is F&S Fresh Foods’ senior executive leader for Quality Assurance, Food Safety, Regulatory Compliance, Supplier Quality, and Customer Quality across all of our facilities. This role sets the enterprise-wide strategy, standards, and systems that keep our products safe, consistent, and compliant with every regulatory, customer, and certification requirement. As the company’s senior authority on food safety risk, audit readiness, and crisis management, you will protect consumers, customers, and the F&S brand while partnering closely with Operations, Supply Chain, Procurement, Product Development, Sales, and Executive Leadership. The ideal candidate is a strategic, data-driven leader who earns the trust of customers and regulators, develops strong teams, and champions a culture where food safety and quality are everyone’s responsibility.

**What You’ll Own**

* Set and execute the long-term Quality and Food Safety strategy, including enterprise goals, standards, KPIs, and governance processes aligned with business objectives
* Lead all corporate Quality Assurance, Food Safety, Regulatory Compliance, Supplier Quality, and Customer Quality functions, ensuring consistent programs across all facilities
* Own the enterprise Food Safety Management System, including HACCP, Preventive Controls, Environmental Monitoring, Allergen Management, Traceability, Food Defense, and pathogen control
* Establish and maintain enterprise quality management systems so products consistently meet specifications, customer expectations, and regulatory requirements
* Ensure compliance with FDA, USDA, FSMA, GFSI, state, local, and customer requirements, interpreting emerging regulations and maintaining audit and inspection readiness at every site
* Serve as senior liaison with regulatory agencies, certification bodies, and customer auditors, overseeing closure of audit findings, regulatory actions, and corrective actions
* Serve as executive authority and decision-maker for food safety incidents, recalls, and crisis response, maintaining risk assessment, traceability, mock recall, and incident management programs
* Represent F&S during customer visits, audits, business reviews, and quality events, building strategic relationships and leading resolution of significant complaints and brand-risk events
* Partner with Commercial, Product Development, and Operations to support growth while maintaining product integrity and improving customer satisfaction
* Establish supplier approval, audit, and monitoring standards and drive supplier performance improvement, partnering with Procurement to mitigate supply chain risk
* Drive data-based improvement to reduce defects, waste, and customer complaints and improve process capability, publishing executive dashboards and performance updates for leadership
* Lead and develop Directors, Managers, and technical leaders, building succession plans, bench strength, and a culture of accountability, engagement, and high performance
* Establish enterprise training standards and competency requirements, partnering with Operations and Human Resources to build food safety and quality into talent development and performance management
* Champion a companywide culture where food safety and quality are everyone’s responsibility, promoting proactive risk identification and continuous improvement
* Serve as the company’s senior subject matter expert on food safety, quality systems, microbiology, compliance, and regulatory matters
* Participate in strategic planning, acquisition integration activities, and enterprise transformation initiatives

Requirements:

**What You Bring**

* Must have: Bachelor’s degree in Food Science, Microbiology, Food Technology, Engineering, or a related scientific discipline; Master’s degree preferred
* Must have: HACCP and Preventive Controls Qualified Individual (PCQI) certifications
* Must have: 15+ years of progressive Quality and Food Safety leadership, including 7+ years leading multi-site organizations
* Must have: Extensive experience in fresh, refrigerated, ready-to-eat, produce, protein, or other highly regulated food manufacturing
* Must have: Proven success leading customer audits, regulatory inspections, certification audits, recalls, and crisis events
* Must have: Strong knowledge of FDA, USDA, FSMA, GFSI, Environmental Monitoring Programs, and Quality Systems
* Nice to have: Lead Auditor, SQF Practitioner, BRCGS, or equivalent certification
* Personal quality: Strategic, consumer- and customer-focused decision-maker who uses metrics, risk assessments, and audit results to set priorities while balancing operational and commercial objectives
* Personal quality: Executive presence and influence with customers, regulators, and leadership, with a track record of building high-performing teams and delivering measurable results

Notice Regarding the Use of Artificial Intelligence in Application Review

**Notice of AI Use in Job Application Review**

As part of our commitment in creating a fair, efficient, and consistent hiring process we may use artificial intelligence (AI) to help our recruiting teams organize, summarize, and analyze information provided by candidates, including resumes, application responses, and other materials submitted during the application process.AI may be used to identify patterns, highlight relevant skills, and experience, and assist in comparing a candidate’s qualifications with the requirement of a specific role. These tools are to improve efficiency and consistency while supporting more informed hiring decisions, which will ultimately be made by the hiring team.

existing_roles.title: Senior Manager, Quality Puerto Rico
existing_roles.description:
**Entity:** CSL Plasma

**Job Category:** Quality

**Job Family:** Plasma Center

**Job Type:** Full Time

**Location****:** Remote, Puerto Rico, United States

**Employer Reference:** R-294561

**Job Description**
-------------------

**The Role**
============

Lead the development and deployment of quality processes and communications with the assigned region; drive quality culture, competent decision-making, appropriate risk assessments, and timely remediation of situations. Maintain frequent and open communications with executive and corporate leaders that focus on timely resolution of issues that may potentially affect the safety, quality, identity, purity, and/or potency of collected plasma. Review and monitor Quality metrics and reports for trends and opportunities for improvement.

 

**Reports To**: Sr. Director, Quality Assurance
 
**Direct Reports:** Assistant Manager of Quality (Approximately 6-7)

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

 
 

* Manage staff, including selecting, training, developing, coaching and terminating, as applicable with guidance from Human Resources. Appraise employee performance and provide feedback and counseling to staff, as applicable.
* Manage compliance to and successful use of the Quality System tools such as change and deviations management.
 
 Ensure regular management review of quality performance that delivers stable, high levels of compliance performance in assigned QA areas. Provide leadership and coordination to established automated systems for control.
* Manage Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) performance to ensure meeting regulatory and departmental requirements, and to drive continual improvement in department processes. Works with CSL applicable systems to analyze and identify significant quality issues/trends and reports those to appropriate Sr. Management. Provides routine reports on the quality KPIs as requested by the applicable business units.
* Maintain understanding of all policies and procedures. Participate in and may lead the development of functional policies and SOPs for assigned areas
* Establish, implement and ensure timely delivery of strategic Quality Assurance performance. Provide direction and guidance on quality topics including resolutions and corrective actions. Perform LSW above center visits. Ensure deployment and sustainability of in-center LSW practices to assigned region.
* Develop & maintain process to disseminate quality interpretation & strategies to operationalize relevant regulations, guidance & standards in collaboration with stakeholders. Maintain & update Quality training materials and provide consistent technical guidance to the operations team. Develop, deploy and occasionally deliver Quality information/publications to appropriate Corporate or Center staff.
* Mentor others on data analysis, technical problem prevention and resolution, design control procedures, investigation processes, and methods to arrive at true root causes as it relates to quality systems.
* Maintain high level of regulatory, compliance and communications skills with department staff, ensuring competence to make decisions and judgments in the course of business, including times of uncertainty.
* Perform other duties, as assigned, to support business needs.
 

 

**Education**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Science, Business Administration or Quality Management required; or
* Minimum 8 years equivalent combination of education, training and experience
* Fluency in English/Spanish

**Experience**

* 5+ years’ experience successfully serving in a leadership role within an FDA-regulated or other regulated industry required
* Minimum 2 years managing people preferred
* Experience in leading projects to a successful conclusion
* Understand regulatory standards, various local, state, and federal laws that apply to the business and where to find information on standards and interpretations
* Computer literate with knowledge of word processing and spreadsheets
* Excellent critical reasoning, decision-making, and problem-solving skills to analyze situations, determine risks, find solutions to prevent future issues, and resolve recurring defects
* Strong leadership, training, written and verbal communication, and interpersonal and presentation skills to drive results
* Organizational skills and ability to manage projects involving multiple tasks by a team with deadlines.
* Good leadership and people management skills are essential in the success of leading project teams.
* Establish solid working relationships with to interface with and support senior management, third parties and other positions and circumstances within the organization
* Excellent customer service orientation with flexibility and adaptability to work as a member of the team and respond quickly to changes as required by the business operations
* Maintain a professional demeanor and handle confidential information with discretion
Lead teams without the benefit of a direct reporting relationship 

**Additional Comments**

The person selected for this position **will need to live/relocate to Puerto Rico**; they will be responsible for above-center quality leadership of all centers on the island.

**Working Conditions (physical & mental requirements)**

* Ability to make decisions which have significant impact on the department’s credibility, operations and services
* Ability to formulate complex and comprehensive materials such as authoritative reports of major scope and impact, etc. and/or to make formal presentations
* Exercise good judgment to refer decisions to management when decisions fall out of the realm of established guidelines
* Overnight travel required up to 50% of the time
* Frequent standing and walking
* Ability to lift or carry up to 25 lbs.
Fast-paced environment with frequent interruptions 

Note: All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, veteran status, national origin or other legally protected classifications

 
 

#GTA

**About CSL Plasma**
--------------------

CSL Plasma operates one of the world's largest and most sophisticated plasma donation networks, with nearly 330 donation centers in the U.S. and Europe. CSL Plasma is a subsidiary of CSL, a global biopharma company. Plasma collected at CSL Plasma facilities is used by CSL for the sole purpose of manufacturing lifesaving plasma-derived therapies for people in more than 100 countries. The parent company, CSL (ASX:CSL; USOTC:CSLLY), headquartered in Melbourne, Australia, employs 29,000+ people. For more information about CSL Plasma visit, https://www.cslplasma.com/.

**Our Benefits**
----------------

For more information on CSL Plasma benefits visit https://cslbenefits.com/cslp.

**You Belong at CSL**
---------------------

At CSL, Inclusion and Belonging is at the core of our mission and who we are. It fuels our innovation day in and day out. By celebrating our differences and creating a culture of curiosity and empathy, we are able to better understand and connect with our patients and donors, foster strong relationships with our stakeholders, and sustain a diverse workforce that will move our company and industry into the future.

To learn more visit https://www.csl.com/careers/inclusion-and-belonging

**Equal Opportunity Employer**
------------------------------

CSL is an Equal Opportunity Employer. If you are an individual with a disability and need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application process, please visit https://www.csl.com/accessibility-statement.

**Job Description**

As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer. 
 
DESCRIPTION: 
Join Thermo Fisher Scientific as a Senior Manager, Plant/Site and contribute to global science and healthcare. You'll oversee operations at advanced facilities, ensuring the delivery of high-quality products that help our customers make the world healthier, cleaner, and safer. This leadership role involves advancing operational excellence through Lean manufacturing principles, managing cross-functional teams, and implementing continuous improvement initiatives. 
 
As the site leader, you'll be responsible for developing and executing strategic plans, ensuring regulatory compliance, and maintaining strong customer relationships. You'll support our core values of Integrity, Intensity, Innovation, and Involvement while cultivating a culture of safety, quality, and operational excellence. This role offers the opportunity to implement positive change, support team development, and contribute to scientific advances. 
 
REQUIREMENTS: 

* Advanced Degree plus 6 years of experience, or Bachelor's Degree plus 8 years of experience in operations leadership in sophisticated manufacturing environments
* Preferred Fields of Study: Engineering, Science, Business Management, or related field
* Strong track record implementing Lean Manufacturing and continuous improvement methodologies
* Experience leading teams in FDA-regulated, cGMP, ISO 13485, or similar quality systems
* Demonstrated financial acumen in budget management and operational cost control
* Excellence in developing and executing strategic and annual operating plans
* Proven ability to build and lead high-performing teams in matrix organizations
* Strong project management skills with ability to manage multiple concurrent initiatives
* Experience with quality systems, regulatory compliance, and audit management
* Expert knowledge of operational KPIs and data-driven process improvement
* Outstanding communication and interpersonal skills across all organizational levels

* Proficiency in leading change management initiatives

* Experience of working in a unionized environment.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities
* Ability to travel up to 10-15% as required
* Experience maintaining safety programs and environmental compliance
* Excellent vendor and customer relationship management skills

**Compensation and Benefits**

The salary range estimated for this position based in Connecticut is $131,300.00–$205,000.00.

This position may also be eligible to receive a variable annual bonus based on company, team, and/or individual performance results in accordance with company policy. We offer a comprehensive Total Rewards package that our U.S. colleagues and their families can count on, which includes:

* A choice of national medical and dental plans, and a national vision plan, including health incentive programs
* Employee assistance and family support programs, including commuter benefits and tuition reimbursement
* At least 120 hours paid time off (PTO), 10 paid holidays annually, paid parental leave (3 weeks for bonding and 8 weeks for caregiver leave), accident and life insurance, and short- and long-term disability in accordance with company policy
* Retirement and savings programs, such as our competitive 401(k) U.S. retirement savings plan
* Employees’ Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) offers eligible colleagues the opportunity to purchase company stock at a discount

For more information on our benefits, please visit: https://jobs.thermofisher.com/global/en/total-rewards

existing_roles.title: Senior Manager, Factory Engineering
existing_roles.description:
At Nestlé Health Science, we believe that nutrition, science, and wellness must merge, not collide. Here, we embrace the intrinsic connections of these three pillars, harnessing their collective strength to empower healthier lives. Our broad product portfolio includes renowned brands like Garden of Life®, Nature's Bounty®, Vital Proteins®, Orgain®, Nuun®, BOOST®, Carnation Breakfast Essentials®, Peptamen®, Compleat Organic Blends®, and more. We also have extensive pharmaceutical expertise, offering innovative medicines that aim to prevent, manage, and treat gastrointestinal and metabolic-related diseases.

At Nestlé Health Science, we bring our best for better lives. Our people are challenged to bring fresh, diverse views and make bold moves to empower healthier lives through nutrition. We know brilliant ideas can come from anyone, anywhere. Here we embrace the entrepreneurial spirit and collaborate with teams that champion focused and forward thinking. We are committed to fostering professional growth and celebrating the achievements of our people along the way. We offer dynamic career paths, robust development, opportunities to learn from talented colleagues around the globe, and benefits that support physical, financial, and emotional wellbeing.

Join us to innovate for impact and reimagine the future of health and nutrition for patients and consumers.

**POSITION OVERVIEW:** 
The Senior Manager, Factory Engineering position is responsible for managing the engineering activities relating to the factory and provide professional engineering and strategic technical leadership in the Factory, ensuring people health and safety, product safety and environment are never compromised. Strategic leader for engineering function, leveraging Nestle’s leadership principles in the following areas; capital execution, asset maintenance and utilities excellence, engineering compliance, and sustainability.

Important Note: This position offers relocation assistance.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Define, propose and monitor the implementation of the Factory Engineering teams plans and objectives in accordance with the Engineering Policy, Key Principles and the Key Engineering Activities as outlined in the Nestlé Engineering Excellence (NEE) master document.
* Live Nestle leadership principles in all aspects of the role.
* Set the technical strategic vision for the factory, leveraging other functional leaders and cascade objectives to all leaders in engineering department, within factory cost targets.
* Develop and maintain technical competencies at the factory, including detailed action plans, accountability to progress, talent review, career and succession planning.
* Drive equipment reliability through implementing maintenance foundations in TPM.
* Build cooperation and collaboration with the production and other cross functional teams to build world class operation.
* Improve maintenance cost structure by improving technical skill sets and optimizing 3rd party spend.
* Implement Nestle capital process to drive excellence in capital execution.
* Proactively develop, maintain and execute the capital market business strategy (MBS) to align with the business needs.
* Drive factory master planning to facilitate long term strategies across the factory for example in Safety, Quality and Warehouse.
* Ensure full compliance with all governing bodies for utilities system relevant to the Modesto site. This is paramount and non-negotiable to have strong understanding in these utilities system.
* Maintain reliability through implementing maintenance foundations and TPM methodology.
* Develop and maintain all skillset necessary for internal management of utilities systems.
* Drive and execute plant sustainability objectives in line with market targets.
* Drive world class water management in the factory.
* Drive reliability in all electrical components in the factory.
* Develop and drive automation plan for the factory.
* Ensure full compliance with Nestle standards including calibration.
* Develop technical skills in maintenance to ensure electrical reliability.
* Drive Innovation/Renovation, initiating/coordinating implementation of new processes/technology with relevant Market, Product Technology Center, Corporate and Strategic Business Unit.
* Cascaded objectives to all leaders that are in-line with factory objectives.
* Implement strategic technical OMP and factory master plan.
* Detailed cost management plan for all aspects of engineering including YoY improvements.
* Detailed action plan for all aspects of technical execution.
* Leverage Maintenance Foundations/TPM.
* Leverage corporate resources and Nestle Market standards.

**EXPERIENCE AND EDUCATION REQUIREMENTS:**

* University Degree (BA/BS) in Engineering, preferably Mechanical, Chemical, Process or equivalent experience is required.
* At least 10 years related work experience is strongly preferred with at least 3 years of leadership/management experience.
* Knowledge of food safety, regulatory requirements for food safety and hygienic engineering (OSH&R) preferred.
* Strong understanding of, or ability to learn, the full scope of role responsibilities, including financial analysis and key business drivers such as Nestlé Standard Costing, Asset and Maintenance Management (AMM), CAPEX budgeting and preparation (CIAT), and Industrial Services/Energy Management (NEMT).
* Familiarity with TPM and continuous improvement methodologies.
* Proficiency with AutoCAD, Visio, CDM, AMM, ESAT, CIAT, NEMT and similar technical tools/systems.
* Demonstrated technical and managerial capabilities with in depth knowledge of food processing plant operations, technologies, utilities, maintenance systems, and hygienic engineering requirements (OSH&R).
* Strong analytical and problem solving skills with the ability to apply root cause analysis and technical creativity to resolve complex short and long term issues.
* Effective communication and networking skills, with the ability to perform under pressure and in ambiguous environments.
* Experience in Project Engineering/Management, including plant design and construction.

Salary: $175,964.40 to $217,029.60 per year

Bonus Eligibility: Yes

The pay range provided is a good faith estimate for the position at the time of posting. Final compensation may vary based on factors including but not limited to knowledge, skills and abilities as well as geographic location. It is not typical for an individual to be hired at top of range.

Nestlé offers performance-based incentives and a competitive total rewards package, which includes a 401k with company match, healthcare coverage and a broad range of other benefits. Incentives and/or benefit packages may vary depending on the position. Learn more at https://www.nestlejobs.com/nestle-in-the-us-benefits

In addition, with our commitment to an inclusive work environment, we recognize the exceptional engagement and innovation displayed by individuals with disabilities. **Job Description:**

**Job Title:**

**Senior Plant Manager** (Corona, CA)

**Collaborate with Innovative 3Mers Around the World**

Choosing where to start and grow your career has a major impact on your professional and personal life, so it’s equally important you know that the company that you choose to work at, and its leaders, will support and guide you. With a wide variety of people, global locations, technologies and products, 3M is a place where you can collaborate with 96,000 other curious, creative 3Mers.

**This position provides an opportunity to transition from other private, public, government or military environments to a 3M career.**

**The Impact You’ll Make in this Role** 
As the **Senior Plant Manager,** you will have the opportunity to tap into your curiosity and collaborate with some of the most innovative people around the world. Here, you will make an impact by:

 

* Active and visible EHS ownership to ensure site compliance, stewardship and championing continuous improvement efforts to improve all aspects of EHS.
* Accountable for strategic planning and budgeting to drive sustainable improvements in factory cost through application of Lean Six Sigma, entitlement thinking, yield improvement, plant productivity and capital planning.
* Implement lean manufacturing principles and methodology to drive employee engagement and continuous improvement, with a strong focus on TPM, 5S and Standard work.
* Managing supply chain execution and inventory management to ensure appropriate supply chain performance through responsiveness, delivery performance, capacity management, supplier management, and appropriate inventory management.
* Represent 3M and engage with key accounts.
* Engaging the community by representing 3M in community affairs as appropriate and foster good public relations in the local community.

**Your Skills and Expertise**

To set you up for success in this role from day one, 3M requires (at a minimum) the following qualifications:

 

* Bachelor's degree or higher (completed and verified prior to start)
* Three (3) years of supervisory and/or management experience in a private, public, government or military environment
* Five (5) years of manufacturing experience in a private, public, government or military environment

Additional qualifications that could help you succeed even further in this role include:

 

* Certified LSS BB or MBB
* Experience in Operations Management
* Union experience a plus
* Expert knowledge and experience in production management, lean manufacturing and materials control
* Strong Communication and Change Management skills
* Experience in Lean manufacturing methodologies in driving value stream improvement.
* Prior Plant Manager Experience

**Location:** Onsite Corona, CA

**Travel:** May include up to 10% domestic/international

**Relocation Assistance:** May be authorized

**Must be legally authorized to work in country of employment without sponsorship for employment visa status (e.g., H1B status).**

**Supporting Your Well-being**

3M offers many programs to help you live your best life – both physically and financially. To ensure competitive pay and benefits, 3M regularly benchmarks with other companies that are comparable in size and scope.

For assistance with searching through our current job openings or for more information about all things 3M, visit Max, our virtual recruiting assistant on 3M.com/careers.

existing_roles.title: Sr. Manager, Flight Coordination Quality & Tr
existing_roles.description:
**Title Options:** Flight Coordination Quality & Training Manager

**Location:** Remote, US

**Reports to:** VP of Flight Coordination

**Hours:** Monday – Friday 8:30 am – 5:30 pm

**Position Summary**

The **Flight Coordination Quality & Training Manager** represents a quality-control and workforce-development function similar to those found in high-performing contact centers and service-delivery organizations. The role ensures every incoming lead, whether received by phone, web form, chat, or referral, is responded to promptly, handled consistently, accurately qualified, fully documented, and advanced through the appropriate next step. Through quality assurance, coaching, training, performance analytics, workflow oversight, and cross-functional coordination, this role strengthens Flight Coordinator performance while protecting the patient and partner experience from first contact through flight execution

This is a hands-on leadership role responsible for continuously reviewing lead interactions, identifying performance and process gaps, and translating findings into targeted coaching, training, and development initiatives. The individual reviews call recordings, chats, web submissions, referral activity, CRM records, follow-up activity, and department handoffs to identify quality risks before they affect a patient, referring facility, payer, partner, or flight outcome.

**How this role impacts our mission**

Every day, families, healthcare providers, and case managers rely on our team to help navigate complex situations and coordinate critical air medical transportation. As the nation's largest fixed-wing air ambulance operator, our mission is to make those moments easier through compassionate, expert air medical transportation, connecting patients with the care they need and getting them to that destination.

The Flight Coordination team is often the first point of contact, serving as a trusted guide through a time-sensitive and highly emotional process. As the FC Quality & Training Manager, you will strengthen team performance through coaching, training, quality oversight, and continuous improvement – helping Flight Coordinators build the skills and confidence to deliver compassionate, accurate, and professional service while advancing opportunities efficiently and supporting patients throughout their journey.

This is an opportunity to shape the experience of both our team members and the families we serve. By improving quality, readiness, and operational consistency, you will help ensure that every patient, provider, and referral partner receives the highest level of care and support throughout their journey.

**Core ownership**

Own quality control across every inbound lead channel and protect forward movement through two distinct stages: (1) incoming lead to qualified opportunity and (2) active opportunity to completed flight or a fully documented, supportable lost outcome.

**Essential Responsibilities**

**1. Intake Quality & Opportunity Readiness**

* Monitor incoming inquiry channels, queues, assignment, and response times to ensure every viable inquiry is acknowledged and actively worked within established service expectations.
* Review calls and transcripts for discovery, active listening, empathy, urgency recognition, value communication, objection handling, qualification, closing language, and clear next steps.
* Audit whether Flight Coordinators appropriately advance, nurture, close, or disqualify inquiries.

* Review inquiries marked false, invalid, duplicate, unqualified, or closed-lost. Challenge, reopen, or escalate records when the disposition is unsupported or a viable opportunity may have been missed.
* Identify conversion and process gaps by coordinator, source, payer type, referral source, service type, call scenario, shift, and funnel stage.
* Maintain a standardized intake-quality scorecard and documented expectations for what strong performance looks like.

**2. Flight Readiness & Coordination Oversight**

* Serves as a cross-departmental liaison with Clinical Operations and Revenue Cycle Management to confirm required clinical reviews, financial clearance, authorizations, documentation, and follow-through are progressing on time and that each opportunity is fully prepared to fly.
* Monitor active opportunities until they become completed flights or reach a documented and supportable lost outcome.
* Confirm each opportunity has a clear next action, responsible owner, due date, and follow-up plan.
* Audit records for required patient, clinical, financial, facility, authorization, payer, transportation, logistics, and operational information.
* Identify aging, stalled, inactive, or incomplete opportunities and intervene before the flight is delayed or lost.
* Ensure follow-up continues after an inquiry is advanced to an opportunity and that ownership does not stop at the initial commitment.
* Audit documentation and coordination steps for completeness before and after handoff.
* Strong ability to identify revenue and service leakage, determine root causes, and translate findings into corrective action.

**Quality Review, Coaching & Development**

* Establish and maintain a consistent review methodology across inbound calls, outbound follow-up, quote conversations, high-urgency inquiries, lost-flight interactions, and other priority scenarios.
* Conduct recurring one-on-one coaching using specific examples from calls, transcripts, records, and workflow activity.
* Create documented coaching plans with clear behaviors, actions, due dates, and follow-up review.
* Recognize strong performance and share repeatable best practices across the team.
* Measure whether coaching produces sustained improvement and escalate recurring quality or workflow concerns to Flight Coordination leadership.
* Partner with leaders on focused development plans when additional support or accountability is needed.

**4. Training & Team Readiness**

* Translate quality findings into targeted training, refreshers, job aids, talk tracks, checklists, and scenario-based exercises.

* Identify recurring themes that require team-wide training rather than individual coaching.
* Coordinate subject-matter input from Revenue Cycle Management, Clinical Operations, Logistics, and other operational partners.
* Maintain current process guidance and a centralized source of truth for Flight Coordination expectations.
* Support new-hire onboarding, readiness reviews, and ongoing proficiency checks.
* Track training completion, understanding, and sustained application on the job.

**5. Cross-Functional Handoff Quality**

* Serve as the primary quality liaison between Flight Coordination and departments receiving or supporting active opportunities.
* Establish clear handoff reuirements, ownership expectations, and acceptance criteria with partner departments.
* Audit documentation and coordination steps for completeness before and after handoff.
* Strong ability to identify revenue and service leakage, determine root causes, and translate findings into corrective action.

**SENIOR MANAGER, QUALITY IMPROVEMENT**

**What you’ll do.**

As the Senior Manager, Quality Improvement, you’ll help neurologists put evidence into practice by managing the processes that support clinical practice guidelines, evidence-based publications, and resources. You’ll advance the AAN’s strategic objectives by supporting the development of timely, evidence-based clinical guidelines, editorial and dissemination strategies, and meaningful resources that engage neurologists in improving their practice. Working across divisions, you’ll connect clinical practice and quality efforts to deliver value for AAN members.

**Please review the attached job description for full details. If viewing from an external site, please visit** **https://www.aan.com/about-the-aan/work-at-the-aan****.**

**Who we are.**

Join a diverse community of fun, energetic, and dedicated employees and members who are committed to supporting neurologists worldwide in providing exceptional care to their patients. The AAN's vision is to be indispensable to our members, and we continue to embrace our values of Community, Leadership, Well-being and Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion. Together, we pursue our mission to enhance member career fulfillment and promote brain health for all.

The AAN, founded in Minneapolis in 1948, supports and represents more than 44,000 neurologists and neuroscience professionals worldwide who provide crucial patient care, seek new cures and treatments for brain disease and work to ensure patient access to the right care. Our headquarters is in a stunning, energy-efficient office, located in downtown Minneapolis’s dynamic Mill District, and our public policy office is near the action on Capitol Hill in Washington, DC. Both locations offer easy access to light rail, major bus lines, parking options, walking/biking paths, and a myriad of dining and entertainment choices, making it a vibrant hub for everyone.

**What we look for.**

**Education:**

* Bachelor's degree in Public Health, Health Care Management, Health Sciences, Nursing, or related field

**Experience:**

* Minimum of 5 years of related experience in healthcare management and quality improvement
* Minimum of 3 years of supervisory experience
* Minimum of 3 years of project management experience
* Demonstrated ability to uphold the AAN’s values
* Demonstrated ability to supervise a team in a fast-paced environment and nurture individual career development and growth
* Ability to provide clear instructions and successful presentations to staff, work groups and panels
* Demonstrated skill, tact, diplomacy, confidentiality, and professionalism in interactions with teams, members, and other relevant individuals or groups
* Demonstrated proficiency using MS Office for word, spreadsheet, and presentations
* Excellent time management skills, ability to deliver results when facing multiple projects with tight deadlines
* Advanced knowledge of evidence-based medicine and clinical practice guideline development is preferred
* Knowledge of established evidence grading, and recommendation-development methods, such as GRADE or comparable frameworks is preferred
* Experience leading multidisciplinary teams and physician or subject-matter expert panels through complex evidence-based projects is preferred
* Demonstrated experience providing strategic and operational leadership for multiple concurrent, multi-year programs or projects is preferred
* Experience identifying and implementing process improvements, technology, or emerging approaches is preferred

*Relevant education and/or experience exceeding the required qualifications may be substituted on a year-for-year basis.*

existing_roles.title: Senior Director, Quality Control
existing_roles.description:
Crescent Biopharma’s vision is to build a world leading oncology company bringing the next wave of therapies for cancer patients. The Company’s clinical-stage pipeline includes its lead program, a PD-1 x VEGF bispecific antibody, as well as novel antibody-drug conjugates. By leveraging multiple modalities and established targets, Crescent aims to rapidly advance potentially transformative therapies as single agents and as part of combination regimens to treat a range of solid tumors. For more information, visit www.crescentbiopharma.com and follow the Company on LinkedIn and X.

We are seeking an experienced Senior Director, Quality Control to join as a key leader within Crescent's Quality organization, responsible for providing strategic and hands-on Quality Control leadership across company’s biologics and ADC programs, and future pipeline growth. Partnering closely with Analytical Sciences, GMP Quality Assurance, CMC/Technical Operations, Supply Chain, and Regulatory Affairs, you will provide phase-appropriate QC oversight from early development through late-stage development and commercialization within a global outsourced testing and manufacturing network. You will ensure reliable release and stability testing while building the QC infrastructure, laboratory network, and operating controls needed to advance programs into Phase 3, PPQ, BLA/MAA submission, and commercial readiness.

Crescent's operating model requires clear, collaborative accountability between Analytical Sciences and QC. Analytical Sciences leads analytical development and performs the primary technical work through method development, characterization, qualification, validation strategy, and PPQ readiness. QC provides oversight and operational input during early development, assumes increasing responsibility for method transfer, validation execution oversight, laboratory readiness, and GMP testing as programs mature, and takes primary ownership of routine QC operations and analytical method lifecycle management following transition to late-stage and commercial operations.

Success in this role requires a collaborative, hands-on leader who understands both analytical development and commercial QC operations, can establish effective governance across internal and external partners, and thrives in a fast-paced biotechnology environment while balancing scientific rigor, compliance, speed, and pragmatism.

### **Responsibilities**

* Define and implement Crescent's phase-appropriate QC strategy and operating model across early development, Phase 3, PPQ, regulatory submission, and commercialization, with clear decision rights and handoffs among Analytical Sciences, QC, and GMP QA.
* Oversee QC activities for drug substance, drug product, intermediates, finished goods, in-process, release, characterization, and stability testing across the portfolio.
* Provide QC oversight and operational requirements during early development while Analytical Sciences leads method development, characterization, qualification, validation strategy, and method maturation through PPQ readiness.
* Partner with Analytical Sciences on integrated Phase 3 and PPQ readiness, including method validation and transfer, laboratory qualification, specifications, reference standards and critical reagents, stability, sample management, and testing timelines.
* Lead QC execution oversight for method transfer, validation, and laboratory readiness; following transition to GMP QC operations, own routine method lifecycle management, performance monitoring, changes, revalidation, transfers, and remediation.
* Lead outsourced GMP QC operations, including sample management and testing coordination, and ensure timely, compliant release and stability testing for clinical supply, PPQ, batch disposition, regulatory commitments, and future commercial supply.
* Partner with Analytical Sciences, CMC, Regulatory Affairs, and QA on specifications and stability strategy; lead operational implementation, stability execution, data review, trending, and escalation within the QC network.
* Establish and oversee reference standard and critical reagent programs, including qualification, bridging, inventory, monitoring, replacement, and lifecycle planning.
* Provide technical leadership for OOS, OOT, OOE, atypical results, invalid assays, laboratory deviations, CAPAs, and change controls, ensuring scientifically sound, timely investigations and risk-based escalation.
* Lead selection, onboarding, qualification, governance, and performance management of CDMO QC functions and contract laboratories, including agreements, capacity, metrics, issue management, data integrity, and inspection readiness.
* Provide QC input to CMC and regulatory strategies and support IND/IMPD, BLA/MAA, health authority, and inspection activities; ensure commitments are implemented within the laboratory network.
* Lead alliance management with business partners on QC matters, including governance, roles and responsibilities, shared testing and release requirements, issue escalation, decision-making, and alignment on development, regulatory, and future commercial priorities.
* Establish scalable QC procedures, systems, metrics, budgeting, forecasting, and resource plans; support compliant use of LIMS, stability, analytical data, and trending tools, and build internal QC capability as Crescent advances toward commercialization.
* Mentor staff and consultants and foster a culture of scientific rigor, collaboration, accountability, inclusion, and continuous improvement while staying current with evolving GMP, ICH, compendial, and industry expectations.

### **Education & Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in life sciences, analytical sciences, biochemistry, pharmaceutical sciences, or a related discipline; advanced degree preferred.
* A minimum 10-12 years of progressive experience in biologics QC, analytical development, or related CMC functions, including leadership of GMP QC operations in an outsourced environment.
* Experience with biologics analytical methods, including cell-based bioassays/potency assays; ADC and other complex biologic modality experience is preferred.
* Experience supporting biologics from clinical development through Phase 3, PPQ, BLA/MAA, and commercial readiness; bispecific antibody, ADC, or other complex modality experience is a plus.
* Proven experience transitioning methods from development into routine GMP QC use, including qualification, validation, transfer, implementation, performance monitoring, and lifecycle management.
* Strong experience with release and stability testing, specifications, reference standards and critical reagents, OOS/OOT/OOE investigations, analytical trending, deviations, CAPAs, and change control.
* Demonstrated success overseeing CDMO QC functions and contract laboratories, including qualification, governance, investigations, capacity, performance, and issue resolution.
* Strong knowledge of global GMP regulations, FDA/EMA/ICH guidance, compendial expectations, data integrity, Part 11 / Annex 11, and phase-appropriate application across development and commercial operations.
* Experience supporting regulatory submissions, health authority questions, pre-approval inspections, and commercial inspection readiness.
* Ability to establish clear roles and effective collaboration among Analytical Sciences, QC, GMP QA, CMC/Technical Operations, Regulatory Affairs, Supply Chain, and external partners.
* Strategic thinker with a hands-on approach, solutions-oriented leader who communicates clearly, applies pragmatic science- and risk-based judgment, works effectively in a fast-paced small-company environment, and can travel to external sites as needed.
* Commitment to living Crescent’s core values and operating norms.

### **What We Offer**

* Opportunity to join a mission-driven team where you'll contribute to impactful work, take on varied responsibilities, and grow quickly in a dynamic environment
* Competitive compensation, including base salary, performance bonus, and equity
* 100% employer-paid benefits package
* Flexible PTO
* Two, one-week company-wide shutdowns each year
* A commitment to your professional development, with access to resources, mentorship, and growth opportunities

### **Salary Range**

The salary range for this position is $260,000 to $285,000. The final salary offered will depend on several factors, which may include, but is not limited to relevant years of experience, educational background, and geography.

**Additional Description for Pay Transparency:**

The final salary offered will depend on several factors, which may include, but is not limited to relevant years of experience, educational background, and geography. Subject to the terms of their respective plans, employees and/or eligible dependents are eligible to participate in the following Company sponsored employee benefit programs: medical, dental, vision, life insurance, short- and long-term disability. Subject to the terms of their respective plans, employees are eligible to participate in the Company’s savings plan (401(k)). This position is eligible to participate in the Company’s long-term incentive program. Subject to the terms of their respective policies and date of hire, Employees are eligible for the following time off benefits: Vacation – Unlimited PTO; Sick time – 10 days per calendar year; Holiday pay, including two Company shut downs; Parental Leave – 16 weeks within one year of the birth/adoption/foster care of a child; FMLA; Military Leave. Additional information can be found - https://www.crescentbiopharma.com/careers/#benefits

Please note:

Crescent Biopharma is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace where all individuals are valued and respected. Employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business needs, without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected status.

**Please note, Crescent does not accept unsolicited resumes from external agencies or recruiters. Submission of a resume without a prior written agreement does not create any express or implied contract between Crescent and the agency. Crescent will not pay any fees related to unsolicited resumes.**

existing_roles.description:
**Since 1869, we've connected people through food they love. We’re proud to be stewards of amazing brands that people trust. Our portfolio includes the iconic Campbell’s brand, as well as Cape Cod, Chunky, Goldfish, Kettle Brand, Lance, Late July, Pacific Foods, Pepperidge Farm, Prego, Pace, Rao’s Homemade, Snack Factory, Snyder’s of Hanover. Swanson, and V8.**

**Here, you will make a difference every day. You will be supported to build a rewarding career with opportunities to grow, innovate and inspire. Make history with us.**

**Why Campbell’s…**

* Benefits begin on day one and include medical, dental, short and long-term disability, AD&D, and life insurance (for individual, families, and domestic partners).
* Employees are eligible for our matching 401(k) plan and can enroll on the first day of employment with immediate vesting.
* Campbell’s offers unlimited sick time along with paid time off and holiday pay.
* If in WHQ – free access to the fitness center. Access to on-site day care (operated by Bright Horizons) and company store.
* Giving back to the communities where our employees work and live is very important to Campbell’s. Our “Campbell’s Cares” program matches employee donations and/or volunteer activity up to $1,500 annually.
* Campbell’s has a variety of Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) to support employees.

**Sr. Director, Supply Quality and Warehouse and Distribution Quality**

The Sr. Director, Supply Quality and Warehouse and Distribution Quality is responsible for leading a comprehensive supply quality, warehouse quality, and distribution quality program across ingredients, packaging, suppliers, warehouses, distributors, and external partners. This role partners closely with Quality, Procurement, Supply Chain, R&D, Regulatory, Legal, plant operations, warehouse and distribution teams, suppliers, brokers, distributors, customers, and third parties to drive quality, compliance, supply continuity, and execution excellence. The director establishes and executes strategy, strengthens governance and systems, leverages data and digital tools to proactively manage risk, serves as a key customer interface, and owns critical customer quality relationships to build trust, resolve issues, and deliver on customer, consumer, brand, and business expectations.

 

**What you will do…**

* Strategic Leadership: Define, communicate, and execute the supply quality and warehouse and distribution quality strategy, roadmap, objectives, and programs across the supply network. Lead with a systems-thinking approach to prioritize risk, align resources, and drive measurable results.
* Category and Network Oversight: Provide leadership across ingredient, packaging, supplier, warehouse, and distributor categories, applying deep quality expertise to materials, storage, handling, processes, and network performance.
* Standards and Systems Management: Establish, interpret, communicate, and strengthen policies, standards, procedures, specifications, verification, and validation processes to ensure consistent execution of warehouse, distribution, regulatory, and quality expectations.
* Risk and Compliance Leadership: Identify, assess, and mitigate quality, regulatory, operational, and reputational risks across the supply base, warehouse network, and distribution network. Oversee risk assessments, ratings, audits, compliance, nonconformances, and business continuity actions.
* Audit and Verification Oversight: Lead audit strategy and governance, including planning, auditor capability development, execution oversight, corrective action follow-up, and continuous improvement of supplier, warehouse, and distributor verification programs.
* Performance Management and Analytics: Lead the use of metrics, data analytics, digital tools, and AI-enabled insights to monitor supplier, warehouse, and distributor performance, identify trends, accelerate decision-making, and improve accountability, transparency, and consistency.
* Supplier, Warehouse, and Distributor Performance: Oversee relationship management, improvement initiatives, contract and performance reviews, and resource deployment to improve quality, compliance, and service outcomes across the network.
* Regulatory and Industry Leadership: Apply deep knowledge of applicable regulations and industry expectations to guide program design, ensure compliance, and influence best-in-class execution across the supply, warehouse, and distribution network.
* Customer Interface and Relationship Ownership: Serve as a key customer interface for quality-related matters and own strategic customer relationships. Build credibility and trust, lead quality discussions, respond to customer concerns, align on expectations, and drive effective resolution of quality, compliance, and service issues.
* Cross-Functional and Enterprise Collaboration: Partner across supply chain, quality, regulatory, legal, R&D, operations, and external stakeholders to align priorities, influence change, and deliver integrated solutions that protect the business and strengthen performance.
* People and Resource Leadership: Lead, coach, and develop talent while overseeing internal, supplier, and third-party resources. Build a high-performing team environment focused on accountability, capability building, and continuous improvement.
Benchmarking and Continuous Improvement: Benchmark internal and external best practices, incorporate learnings into systems and processes, and drive future-ready capabilities across supply quality and warehouse and distribution quality. 

 

**Who you will work with…**

Collaborate closely with Quality, Procurement, Supply Chain, R&D, Legal, Regulatory, plant operations, warehouse and distribution teams, suppliers, distributors, brokers, customers, and third-party partners.

 

**What you bring to the table… (Must Have)**

* Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree in a relevant field preferred.
* 10+ years of progressive quality, supply quality, warehouse quality, or distribution quality management experience in food manufacturing, consumer products, logistics, or a related industry.
* Demonstrated leadership in supplier quality, warehouse and distribution quality systems, regulatory compliance, and cross-functional program management.
* Strong capability in risk assessment, strategic planning, stakeholder influence, data-driven decision-making, and leading through complexity.
* Experience leading teams, developing talent, and managing external partners and third-party resources.
Ability to travel up to 50% depending on business, audit, and project needs. 

 

**It would be great to have… (Nice to Have)**

* Experience in supplier quality, warehouse quality, distribution quality, manufacturing operations, or managing complex supply networks in a CPG, food, or logistics environment.
* Certifications such as ASQ, HACCP, PCQI, GFSI, auditing, Six Sigma, Lean, or project management.
* Strong knowledge of quality systems, supplier management, audit programs, warehouse and distribution practices, and applicable FDA, USDA, CFIA, and related regulatory requirements.
Experience leveraging systems, analytics, and digital tools to strengthen visibility, compliance, and performance management. 

 

**Compensation and Benefits:**

The target base salary range for this full-time, salaried position is between

$203,000-$279,200

Individual base pay depends on work location and additional factors such as experience, job-related skills, and relevant education or training. Total pay may include other forms of compensation. In addition, we offer competitive health, dental, 401k and wellness benefits beginning on the first day of employment. Please ask your Talent Acquisition Partner for more information about our total rewards package.

existing_roles.title: Quality Engineering Manager, Payments Technology - Senior Vice President
existing_roles.description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

**Job Overview**
----------------

As Senior Vice President, Quality Engineering Manager for Payments Technology, you will own the test strategy for CitiDirect, Citi's award winning digital banking platform that gives clients one-click access to global transaction capabilities across payments, liquidity and trade. You will direct multiple testing teams, set the standards for test automation and User Acceptance Testing, and make sure every release of CitiDirect and its connected systems meets a high quality bar before reaching production. This is an opportunity to shape how a global bank validates mission critical payments technology and to build a modern, automated testing organization.

 
 

**Responsibilities**

* Lead the test strategy for CitiDirect and its upstream and downstream applications across the Payments, Liquidity and Trade domains.

* Direct multiple testing teams, setting priorities and resolving complex issues that carry significant business impact.

* Design and implement User Acceptance Testing scripts and plans together with technology project managers, UAT professionals and business users.

* Build testing standards and quality benchmarks that keep automation, documentation and release processes consistent across teams.

* Plan and coordinate cross-team testing dependencies to keep releases on schedule and reduce production risk.

* Partner with development teams, IT project managers, business stakeholders and external vendors to align testing approach with delivery goals.

* Manage team performance and development, including hiring, coaching, compensation decisions and career planning for testing professionals.

* Assess risk in every release decision and escalate control issues early to protect Citi and its clients.

**Required Qualifications & Skills**

* 10+ years of experience in a testing environment, including senior level people management experience.

* Deep understanding of Systems Development Life Cycle processes and end to end testing methodologies.

* Hands-on experience with test management tools such as Quality Center and related testing platforms.

* Clear and concise written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to negotiate and influence at a senior level.

* Strong analytical skills, with the ability to work through complex and unfamiliar testing situations.

* A track record of leading teams to deliver high quality results under tight deadlines.

* A bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience in a related field.

**Beneficial Skills & Qualifications**

* Working knowledge of API testing tools such as Postman, Rest Assured or SoapUI.

* Programming skills in Java, Python or JavaScript, combined with background in payments technology, cloud platforms and Agile or Scrum delivery, and a track record of moving manual QA functions to automated testing.:

* Playwright & TypeScript/JavaScript Mastery (Required): Extensive hands-on experience designing and implementing scalable, maintainable test automation frameworks from scratch using Playwright and TypeScript/JavaScript.

* CI/CD Pipeline Integration & Quality Gating (Required): In-depth experience establishing continuous testing workflows within CI/CD pipelines, including setting up automated regression triggering and pipeline hard gating.

* Containerization & Scaled Infrastructure (Strongly Preferred): Strong background in leveraging Docker and Kubernetes to containerize test suites and horizontally scale distributed test execution across enterprise environments.

* GenAI & Agentic Testing Workflows (Strongly Preferred): Experience using AI Harnesses (e.g., GitHub Copilot or Claude) and creating custom AI agents or automated agentic workflows to optimize the software testing lifecycle.

**Education:**
